verses.text_gb_plain: 便查知他被告，是因他们律法的问题，并没有什么该死该绑的罪名。
verses.text_big5_plain: 便查知他被告，是因他們律法的問題，並沒有甚麼該死該綁的罪名。

refs.text_gb: 这个人煽动人不按着律法敬拜神。
refs.text_big5: 這個人煽動人不按著律法敬拜神。
refs.text_en: Saying, This man incites men to worship God contrary to the law.

refs.text_gb: 但所争论的，若是关于言语、名目和你们中间的律法，你们自己看着办吧，这些事我不愿意审问。
refs.text_big5: 但所爭論的，若是關於言語、名目和你們中間的律法，你們自己看著辦罷，這些事我不願意審問。
refs.text_en: But if there are questions concerning words and names and your own law, look after it yourselves. A judge of these things I do not intend to be.

refs.text_gb: 不过是和保罗争论一些他们自己敬鬼神的问题，又关于一位已经死了的耶稣，保罗断言祂是活着的。
refs.text_big5: 不過是和保羅爭論一些他們自己敬鬼神的問題，又關於一位已經死了的耶穌，保羅斷言祂是活著的。
refs.text_en: But they had certain questions against him concerning their own religion and concerning a certain Jesus who had died, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

refs.text_gb: 但我查明他没有犯什么该死的罪，并且他自己既然要上诉于皇上，我就定意把他解去。
refs.text_big5: 但我查明他沒有犯甚麼該死的罪，並且他自己既然要上訴於皇上，我就定意把他解去。
refs.text_en: But I found that he had done nothing worthy of death; and since he himself appealed to the Emperor, I decided to send him.

refs.text_gb: 退到一边，彼此谈论说，这人并没有犯什么该死该绑的罪。
refs.text_big5: 退到一邊，彼此談論說，這人並沒有犯甚麼該死該綁的罪。
refs.text_en: And when they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, This man is doing nothing worthy of death or of bonds.

refs.text_gb: 他们审问了我，就愿意释放我，因为在我身上并没有该定死罪的。
refs.text_big5: 他們審問了我，就願意釋放我，因為在我身上並沒有該定死罪的。
refs.text_en: Who, having examined me, intended to release me, because there was not one cause of death in me.

verses.text_gb: 后来有人把要害这人的[Cra]阴谋[Crb]告诉我，我就立刻解他到你那里去，又吩咐[Crc]告他的人，到你面前告他。
verses.text_big5: 後來有人把要害這人的[Cra]陰謀[Crb]告訴我，我就立刻解他到你那裏去，又吩咐[Crc]告他的人，到你面前告他。
verses.text_en: And when it was disclosed to me that there was a plot against the man, I sent him at once to you, charging the accusers also to speak the things against him before you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 后来有人把要害这人的阴谋告诉我，我就立刻解他到你那里去，又吩咐告他的人，到你面前告他。
verses.text_big5_plain: 後來有人把要害這人的陰謀告訴我，我就立刻解他到你那裏去，又吩咐告他的人，到你面前告他。

refs.text_gb: 到了天亮，犹太人就团结同谋，发咒起誓说，若不先杀保罗，就不吃不喝。
refs.text_big5: 到了天亮，猶太人就團結同謀，發咒起誓說，若不先殺保羅，就不喫不喝。
refs.text_en: And when it became day, the Jews formed a plot and put themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

refs.text_gb: 保罗的外甥听见这埋伏的事，就来，进了营楼，告诉保罗。
refs.text_big5: 保羅的外甥聽見這埋伏的事，就來，進了營樓，告訴保羅。
refs.text_en: But the son of Paul's sister heard of the ambush, and he came and entered into the barracks and reported it to Paul.

refs.text_gb: 保罗请一个百夫长来，说，你带这青年人到千夫长那里，他有事要告诉他。
refs.text_big5: 保羅請一個百夫長來，說，你帶這青年人到千夫長那裏，他有事要告訴他。
refs.text_en: And Paul called one of the centurions to him and said, Bring this young man to the commander, for he has something to report to him.

refs.text_gb: 于是百夫长拉着他，带到千夫长那里，说，被囚的保罗请我到他那里，求我带这青年人到你这里，他有事要告诉你。
refs.text_big5: 於是百夫長拉著他，帶到千夫長那裏，說，被囚的保羅請我到他那裏，求我帶這青年人到你這裏，他有事要告訴你。
refs.text_en: So he took him and brought him to the commander and said, The prisoner Paul called me to him and asked me to bring this young man to you, because he has something to tell you.

refs.text_gb: 千夫长就拉着他的手走到一旁，私下查问说，你有什么事要告诉我？
refs.text_big5: 千夫長就拉著他的手走到一旁，私下查問說，你有甚麼事要告訴我？
refs.text_en: And the commander took him by the hand and, withdrawing privately, inquired, What is it that you have to report to me?

refs.text_gb: 他说，犹太人已经约定，要求你明天带保罗下到议会里去，假作要更详确查问他的事。
refs.text_big5: 他說，猶太人已經約定，要求你明天帶保羅下到議會裏去，假作要更詳確查問他的事。
refs.text_en: And he said, The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down tomorrow to the Sanhedrin, as though they were going to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

refs.text_gb: 你不要听从他们，因为他们中间有四十多人，埋伏着等待保罗，并且已经发咒起誓，若不先杀保罗，就不吃不喝；现在他们预备好了，只等你应允。
refs.text_big5: 你不要聽從他們，因為他們中間有四十多人，埋伏著等待保羅，並且已經發咒起誓，若不先殺保羅，就不喫不喝；現在他們豫備好了，只等你應允。
refs.text_en: So you should not be persuaded by them, for more than forty of their men are lying in ambush for him; they have put themselves under a curse neither to eat nor to drink until they have done away with him. And now they are ready, awaiting the promise from you.

refs.text_gb: 就说，等告你的人来到，我要细听你的事。便吩咐人把他看守在希律的王府里。
refs.text_big5: 就說，等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事。便吩咐人把他看守在希律的王府裏。
refs.text_en: He said, I will hear your case fully when your accusers also arrive. And he ordered him to be guarded in Herod's praetorium.

refs.text_gb: 他们若有告我的事，就应当到你面前来告我。
refs.text_big5: 他們若有告我的事，就應當到你面前來告我。
refs.text_en: Who should have been present before you and made accusation if they had anything against me-

refs.text_gb: 我回答他们说，无论什么人，被告还没有和原告当面对质，未得机会分诉所告他的事，就先把他交给对方，这不是罗马人的规例。
refs.text_big5: 我回答他們說，無論甚麼人，被告還沒有和原告當面對質，未得機會分訴所告他的事，就先把他交給對方，這不是羅馬人的規例。
refs.text_en: To them I answered that it is not the custom with Romans to hand over any man before he who is accused meets the accusers face to face and has an opportunity for a defense concerning the charge.

verses.text_gb: 于是兵丁照所指示他们的，夜里将保罗带到[Fn1]安提帕底。
verses.text_big5: 於是兵丁照所指示他們的，夜裏將保羅帶到[Fn1]安提帕底。
verses.text_en: So the soldiers, according to what they had been directed, took up Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是兵丁照所指示他们的，夜里将保罗带到安提帕底。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是兵丁照所指示他們的，夜裏將保羅帶到安提帕底。

footnotes.zh: 此地离耶路撒冷约有五十九公里，离该撒利亚约有三十八公里。
footnotes.zh_big5: 此地離耶路撒冷約有五十九公里，離該撒利亞約有三十八公里。
footnotes.en: 23:31 1 Antipatris A place about 40 Roman miles from Jerusalem and about 26 from Caesarea.

verses.text_gb: 第二天让马兵同保罗前行，他们就回[Cra]营楼去了。
verses.text_big5: 第二天讓馬兵同保羅前行，他們就回[Cra]營樓去了。
verses.text_en: And on the next day, leaving the horsemen to depart with him, they returned to the barracks.
verses.text_gb_plain: 第二天让马兵同保罗前行，他们就回营楼去了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 第二天讓馬兵同保羅前行，他們就回營樓去了。

refs.text_gb: 那时大起纷争，千夫长恐怕保罗被他们扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他从众人当中抢出来，带进营楼去。
refs.text_big5: 那時大起紛爭，千夫長恐怕保羅被他們扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他從眾人當中搶出來，帶進營樓去。
refs.text_en: And when much dissension had taken place, the commander, fearing that Paul might be torn to pieces by them, ordered the detachment of soldiers to go down and seize him from their midst and bring him into the barracks.

verses.text_gb: 马兵来到[Cra]该撒利亚，把文书呈给总督，也把保罗带到他面前。
verses.text_big5: 馬兵來到[Cra]該撒利亞，把文書呈給總督，也把保羅帶到他面前。
verses.text_en: And when they entered into Caesarea and handed over the letter to the governor, they presented Paul also to him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 马兵来到该撒利亚，把文书呈给总督，也把保罗带到他面前。
verses.text_big5_plain: 馬兵來到該撒利亞，把文書呈給總督，也把保羅帶到他面前。

refs.text_gb: 非斯都到省上任，过了三天，就从该撒利亚上耶路撒冷去。
refs.text_big5: 非斯都到省上任，過了三天，就從該撒利亞上耶路撒冷去。
refs.text_en: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

verses.text_gb: 总督念了，就问保罗是那省的人；既查知他是[Cra]基利家人，
verses.text_big5: 總督念了，就問保羅是那省的人；既查知他是[Cra]基利家人，
verses.text_en: And when he had read it, he asked from what province he was; and learning that he was from Cilicia,
verses.text_gb_plain: 总督念了，就问保罗是那省的人；既查知他是基利家人，
verses.text_big5_plain: 總督念了，就問保羅是那省的人；既查知他是基利家人，

refs.text_gb: 保罗说，我本是犹太人，是基利家的大数人，并不是无名小城的居民，求你准我向百姓说话。
refs.text_big5: 保羅說，我本是猶太人，是基利家的大數人，並不是無名小城的居民，求你准我向百姓說話。
refs.text_en: But Paul said, I am a Jewish man of Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city, and I beg you, permit me to speak to the people.

verses.text_gb: 就说，等[Cra]告你的人来到，我要细听你的事。便吩咐人把他看守在希律的[Fn1][Crb]王府里。
verses.text_big5: 就說，等[Cra]告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事。便吩咐人把他看守在希律的[Fn1][Crb]王府裏。
verses.text_en: He said, I will hear your case fully when your accusers also arrive. And he ordered him to be guarded in Herod's praetorium.

verses.text_big5_plain: 就說，等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事。便吩咐人把他看守在希律的王府裏。

footnotes.zh: 先前的王宫，为大希律王所建，后来成了罗马帝国犹太省总督的官邸。腓力斯很宽大的把保罗看守在这里，没有囚在一般的监狱中。
footnotes.zh_big5: 先前的王宮，為大希律王所建，後來成了羅馬帝國猶太省總督的官邸。腓力斯很寬大的把保羅看守在這裏，沒有囚在一般的監獄中。
footnotes.en: 23:35 1 praetorium The palace of the former kings, built by Herod the Great. It became the official residence of the governor of the Roman province of Judea. Paul was guarded there leniently, not confined in the common prison.

refs.text_en: And when it was disclosed to me that there was a plot against the man, I sent him at once to you, charging the accusers also to speak the things against him before you.

refs.text_gb: 那时，总督的兵丁把耶稣带进总督府，全营都聚集在祂那里。
refs.text_big5: 那時，總督的兵丁把耶穌帶進總督府，全營都聚集在祂那裏。
refs.text_en: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the praetorium and gathered about Him the whole cohort.

refs.text_gb: 众人将耶稣从该亚法那里解往总督府去，那时是清早。他们自己却不进总督府去，恐怕染了污秽，不能吃逾越节的筵席。
refs.text_big5: 眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裏解往總督府去，那時是清早。他們自己卻不進總督府去，恐怕染了污穢，不能喫逾越節的筵席。
refs.text_en: Then they led Jesus from Caiaphas into the praetorium, and it was early morning. And they themselves did not enter into the praetorium, so that they would not be defiled, but might eat the passover.

refs.text_gb: 彼拉多又进了总督府，叫耶稣来，对祂说，你是犹太人的王么？
refs.text_big5: 彼拉多又進了總督府，叫耶穌來，對祂說，你是猶太人的王麼？
refs.text_en: Pilate therefore entered again into the praetorium and called for Jesus. And he said to Him, You are the King of the Jews?

refs.text_gb: 又进总督府，对耶稣说，你是哪里来的？耶稣却不回答。
refs.text_big5: 又進總督府，對耶穌說，你是那裏來的？耶穌卻不回答。
refs.text_en: And he entered into the praetorium again and said to Jesus, Where are You from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

verses.text_gb: 过了五天，大祭司[Cra]亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个[Fn1]辩士帖土罗下来，向[Crb]总督控告保罗。
verses.text_big5: 過了五天，大祭司[Cra]亞拿尼亞同幾個長老，和一個[Fn1]辯士帖土羅下來，向[Crb]總督控告保羅。
verses.text_en: And after five days the high priest Ananias came down with some elders and a certain orator, Tertullus; and they gave their information against Paul to the governor.
verses.text_gb_plain: 过了五天，大祭司亚拿尼亚同几个长老，和一个辩士帖土罗下来，向总督控告保罗。
verses.text_big5_plain: 過了五天，大祭司亞拿尼亞同幾個長老，和一個辯士帖土羅下來，向總督控告保羅。

footnotes.en: 24:1 1 orator I.e., a spokesman, one who knew Roman legal procedure.

refs.text_gb: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐旁边站着的人打他的嘴。
refs.text_big5: 大祭司亞拿尼亞就吩咐旁邊站著的人打他的嘴。
refs.text_en: And the high priest Ananias commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

refs.text_gb: 也要预备牲口叫保罗骑上，把他平安的护送到总督腓力斯那里去。
refs.text_big5: 也要豫備牲口叫保羅騎上，把他平安的護送到總督腓力斯那裏去。
refs.text_en: And they were also to provide mounts to put Paul on and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

verses.text_gb: 保罗被传了来，帖土罗就控告说，
verses.text_big5: 保羅被傳了來，帖土羅就控告說，
verses.text_en: And when Paul was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, Since we have obtained much peace through you, and since reforms are being carried out for this nation through your forethought
verses.text_gb_plain: 保罗被传了来，帖土罗就控告说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 保羅被傳了來，帖土羅就控告說，

verses.text_gb: [Cra]腓力斯[Crb]大人，[Fn1]我们因你得以大享太平，并且这国因你的先见，随事随处得了改革，我们满心感谢的领受。
verses.text_big5: [Cra]腓力斯[Crb]大人，[Fn1]我們因你得以大享太平，並且這國因你的先見，隨事隨處得了改革，我們滿心感謝的領受。
verses.text_en: Both in every way and everywhere, we welcome it, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 腓力斯大人，我们因你得以大享太平，并且这国因你的先见，随事随处得了改革，我们满心感谢的领受。
verses.text_big5_plain: 腓力斯大人，我們因你得以大享太平，並且這國因你的先見，隨事隨處得了改革，我們滿心感謝的領受。

footnotes.zh: 帖土罗在本节所说的话，显示他的卑下，毫无道德标准。见二三1注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 帖土羅在本節所說的話，顯示他的卑下，毫無道德標準。見二三1註3。

refs.text_gb: 也要预备牲口叫保罗骑上，把他平安的护送到总督腓力斯那里去。
refs.text_big5: 也要豫備牲口叫保羅騎上，把他平安的護送到總督腓力斯那裏去。
refs.text_en: And they were also to provide mounts to put Paul on and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

refs.text_gb: 大意如下：革老丢吕西亚请总督腓力斯大人安。
refs.text_big5: 大意如下：革老丟呂西亞請總督腓力斯大人安。
refs.text_en: Claudius Lysias, to his Excellency, Governor Felix, rejoice.

refs.text_gb: 保罗说，非斯都大人，我不是癫狂，我说的乃是真实清醒的话。
refs.text_big5: 保羅說，非斯都大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是真實清醒的話。
refs.text_en: But Paul said, I am not insane, most excellent Festus, but I am uttering words of truth and soberness.

refs.text_gb: 提阿非罗大人哪，因为有好些人已经着手作书，述说在我们中间所完全成就的事，
refs.text_big5: 提阿非羅大人哪，因為有好些人已經著手作書，述說在我們中間所完全成就的事，
refs.text_en: Inasmuch as many have undertaken to draw up a narrative concerning the matters which have been fully accomplished among us,

verses.text_gb: 但为了不多耽误你，只求你宽容，略听我们几句。
verses.text_big5: 但為了不多耽誤你，只求你寬容，略聽我們幾句。
verses.text_en: But that I may not detain you further, I entreat you to hear us briefly in your forbearance.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但为了不多耽误你，只求你宽容，略听我们几句。

refs.text_en: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers in a pure conscience, while unceasingly I have remembrance concerning you in my petitions night and day,

refs.text_gb: 何况基督借着永远的灵，将自己无瑕无疵的献给神，祂的血岂不更洁净我们的良心，使其脱离死行，叫我们事奉活神么？
refs.text_big5: 何況基督藉著永遠的靈，將自己無瑕無疵的獻給神，祂的血豈不更潔淨我們的良心，使其脫離死行，叫我們事奉活神麼？
refs.text_en: How much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered Himself without blemish to God, purify our conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

refs.text_gb: 所以我们既领受了不能震动的国，就当接受恩典，借此得以照神所喜悦的，以虔诚和畏惧事奉神；
refs.text_big5: 所以我們既領受了不能震動的國，就當接受恩典，藉此得以照神所喜悅的，以虔誠和畏懼事奉神；
refs.text_en: Therefore receiving an unshakable kingdom, let us have grace, through which we may serve God well-pleasingly with piety and fear;

refs.text_gb: 你们挂在木头上杀害的耶稣，我们祖宗的神已经叫祂复活了。
refs.text_big5: 你們掛在木頭上殺害的耶穌，我們祖宗的神已經叫祂復活了。
refs.text_en: The God of our fathers has raised Jesus, whom you slew by hanging Him on a tree.

refs.text_gb: 他又说，我们祖宗的神预先选定了你，叫你认识祂的旨意，又得见那义者，且得听祂口中所出的声音；
refs.text_big5: 他又說，我們祖宗的神豫先選定了你，叫你認識祂的旨意，又得見那義者，且得聽祂口中所出的聲音；
refs.text_en: And he said, The God of our fathers has previously appointed you to know His will and to see the righteous One and to hear the voice from His mouth;

refs.text_gb: 然而我蒙神的帮助，直到今日还得站住，向尊卑老幼作见证，所讲的，并不外乎众申言者和摩西所说，必要发生的事，
refs.text_big5: 然而我蒙神的幫助，直到今日還得站住，向尊卑老幼作見證，所講的，並不外乎眾申言者和摩西所說，必要發生的事，
refs.text_en: Having therefore obtained the help which is from God, I have stood unto this day, testifying both to small and great, saying nothing apart from the things which both the prophets and Moses have said would take place,

refs.text_en: And once they had appointed a day for him, many came to him at his lodging, to whom he expounded these matters, solemnly testifying of the kingdom of God and persuading them concerning Jesus from both the Law of Moses and the Prophets, from morning until evening.

refs.text_gb: 因为众申言者和律法申言，到约翰为止；

refs.text_en: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John;

refs.text_big5: 但如今神的義在律法以外已經顯明出來，有律法和申言者為證，
refs.text_en: But now, apart from the law, the righteousness of God has been manifested, witness being borne to it by the Law and the Prophets;

footnotes.zh: 义人的复活要发生在千年国前，主回来的时候(林前十五23，帖前四16)。这是生命的复活(约五28～29上与注，但十二2上)，也是赏赐的复活(路十四14)，包括头一次或上好的复活(启二十4～6与5注1，6注1)、杰出的复活(腓三11与注2)。不义之人的复活要发生在千年国以后(启二十5)，那是审判的复活(约五29下与注)，受羞辱、永远被憎恶的复活(但十二2下)；那时，不义的人要受永远灭亡的审判(启二十12～15与12注1)。使徒在25节以此警告不义的腓力斯(见该处注2)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 義人的復活要發生在千年國前，主回來的時候。（林前十五23，帖前四16。）這是生命的復活，（約五28～29上與註，但十二2上，）也是賞賜的復活，（路十四14，）包括頭一次或上好的復活、（啟二十4～6與5註1，6註1、）傑出的復活。（腓三11與註2。）不義之人的復活要發生在千年國以後，（啟二十5，）那是審判的復活，（約五29下與註，）受羞辱、永遠被憎惡的復活；（但十二2下；）那時，不義的人要受永遠滅亡的審判。（啟二十12～15與12註1。）使徒在25節以此警告不義的腓力斯。（見25註2。）
footnotes.en: 24:15 1 resurrection The resurrection of the righteous will occur before the millennium at the Lord's coming back (1 Cor. 15:23; 1 Thes. 4:16). This will be the resurrection of life (John 5:28-29a and notes; Dan. 12:2a) and the resurrection of reward (Luke 14:14), which includes the first, or the best, resurrection (Rev. 20:4-6 and note Rev. 20:5 2 and note Rev. 20:6 2 ) the out-resurrection (Phil. 3:11 and note Phil. 3:11 2 ). The resurrection of the unrighteous will occur after the millennium (Rev. 20:5). This will be the resurrection of judgment (John 5:29b and notes) and of shame and everlasting contempt (Dan. 12:2b), and will be for the judgment of eternal perdition upon the unrighteous (Rev. 20:12-15 and note Rev. 20:12 1 ). It was concerning this judgment that the apostle warned the unrighteous Felix in v. 25 (see note Acts 24:25 2 ).

refs.text_en: For our boasting is this, the testimony of our conscience, that in singleness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we have conducted ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

verses.text_gb_plain: 即或不然，当我站在议会前，这些人若看出我有不对的地方，他们自己也可以说出来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 即或不然，當我站在議會前，這些人若看出我有不對的地方，他們自己也可以說出來。

refs.text_gb: 保罗定睛看着议会，说，诸位，弟兄们，我在神面前行事为人都是凭着无亏的良心，直到今日。
refs.text_big5: 保羅定睛看著議會，說，諸位，弟兄們，我在神面前行事為人都是憑著無虧的良心，直到今日。
refs.text_en: And Paul, looking intently at the Sanhedrin, said, Men, brothers, I have conducted myself in all good conscience before God until this day.

verses.text_gb: 纵然有，也不过是为了我站在他们中间所喊的这一声：我今日在你们面前受审，是为死人[Cra]复活。
verses.text_big5: 縱然有，也不過是為了我站在他們中間所喊的這一聲：我今日在你們面前受審，是為死人[Cra]復活。
verses.text_en: Other than concerning this one sound which I cried out while standing among them, Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged today before you.
verses.text_gb_plain: 纵然有，也不过是为了我站在他们中间所喊的这一声：我今日在你们面前受审，是为死人复活。
verses.text_big5_plain: 縱然有，也不過是為了我站在他們中間所喊的這一聲：我今日在你們面前受審，是為死人復活。

refs.text_gb: 我向神存着盼望，无论义的和不义的都要复活，就是他们自己也是这样盼望。
refs.text_big5: 我向神存著盼望，無論義的和不義的都要復活，就是他們自己也是這樣盼望。
refs.text_en: Having hope toward God, which these themselves also look for, that there is to be a resurrection of both the righteous and the unrighteous.

refs.text_gb: 保罗看出其中一部分是撒都该人，另一部分是法利赛人，就在议会中喊着说，诸位，弟兄们，我是法利赛人，是法利赛人的子孙；我现在受审问，是为了盼望死人复活。
refs.text_big5: 保羅看出其中一部分是撒都該人，另一部分是法利賽人，就在議會中喊著說，諸位，弟兄們，我是法利賽人，是法利賽人的子孫；我現在受審問，是為了盼望死人復活。
refs.text_en: And Paul, knowing that one part was Sadducees and the other Pharisees, cried out in the Sanhedrin, Men, brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees; concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!

verses.text_gb: 腓力斯既更加详确的晓得关于这[Cra]道路的事，就拖延他们，说，且等[Crb]千夫长吕西亚下来，我要审断你们的事。
verses.text_big5: 腓力斯既更加詳確的曉得關於這[Cra]道路的事，就拖延他們，說，且等[Crb]千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。
verses.text_en: But Felix, knowing more accurately the things concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, When Lysias the commander comes down, I will determine your affairs.
verses.text_gb_plain: 腓力斯既更加详确的晓得关于这道路的事，就拖延他们，说，且等千夫长吕西亚下来，我要审断你们的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 腓力斯既更加詳確的曉得關於這道路的事，就拖延他們，說，且等千夫長呂西亞下來，我要審斷你們的事。

refs.text_gb: 但有一件事我要向你承认，就是我正按着他们所称为异端的道路，事奉我们祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的，和申言者书上一切所记载的；
refs.text_big5: 但有一件事我要向你承認，就是我正按著他們所稱為異端的道路，事奉我們祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的，和申言者書上一切所記載的；
refs.text_en: But I confess this to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all the things that are written in the Law and in the Prophets;

refs.text_gb: 他们正想要杀他，有人报信给营里的千夫长说，全耶路撒冷都乱了。
refs.text_big5: 他們正想要殺他，有人報信給營裏的千夫長說，全耶路撒冷都亂了。
refs.text_en: And as they were seeking to kill him, a report came up to the commander of the cohort that all Jerusalem was in confusion.

verses.text_gb: 于是吩咐百夫长[Cra]看守保罗，并且[Crb]宽待他，也不拦阻他自己的人来供给他。
verses.text_big5: 於是吩咐百夫長[Cra]看守保羅，並且[Crb]寬待他，也不攔阻他自己的人來供給他。
verses.text_en: And he directed the centurion to keep him in custody, and that he should have some liberty and that no one should prevent his own people from attending to him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 于是吩咐百夫长看守保罗，并且宽待他，也不拦阻他自己的人来供给他。
verses.text_big5_plain: 於是吩咐百夫長看守保羅，並且寬待他，也不攔阻他自己的人來供給他。

refs.text_gb: 当我们进了罗马，保罗蒙准和一个看守他的兵丁另住一处。
refs.text_big5: 當我們進了羅馬，保羅蒙准和一個看守他的兵丁另住一處。
refs.text_en: And when we entered into Rome, Paul was permitted to remain by himself with the soldier who was guarding him.

refs.text_gb: 第二天，我们在西顿靠了岸，犹流宽待保罗，准他往朋友那里去，受他们的照应。
refs.text_big5: 第二天，我們在西頓靠了岸，猶流寬待保羅，准他往朋友那裏去，受他們的照應。
refs.text_en: And on the next day we landed at Sidon; and Julius, treating Paul kindly, allowed him to go to his friends to receive care.

verses.text_gb: 过了几天，腓力斯和他夫人犹太的女子[Fn1]土西拉一同来到，就传见保罗，并听他讲论[Cra]信入基督耶稣的事。
verses.text_big5: 過了幾天，腓力斯和他夫人猶太的女子[Fn1]土西拉一同來到，就傳見保羅，並聽他講論[Cra]信入基督耶穌的事。
verses.text_en: But after some days, Felix arrived with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and he sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.
verses.text_gb_plain: 过了几天，腓力斯和他夫人犹太的女子土西拉一同来到，就传见保罗，并听他讲论信入基督耶稣的事。
verses.text_big5_plain: 過了幾天，腓力斯和他夫人猶太的女子土西拉一同來到，就傳見保羅，並聽他講論信入基督耶穌的事。

footnotes.zh: 希律亚基帕王的女儿。腓力斯迷恋她，说服她离弃丈夫与他结婚。这显示罗马政客腓力斯的荒淫腐败。见二三1注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 希律亞基帕王的女兒。腓力斯迷戀她，說服她離棄丈夫與他結婚。這顯示羅馬政客腓力斯的荒淫腐敗。見二三1註3。
footnotes.en: 24:24 1 Drusilla A daughter of King Herod Agrippa. She was persuaded by Felix, who became enamored of her, to forsake her husband and marry him. This showed the intemperance and corruption of Felix, a Roman politician. See note Acts 23:1 3 .

refs.text_gb: 又对犹太人和希利尼人郑重作见证，当悔改归向神，信入我们的主耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 又對猶太人和希利尼人鄭重作見證，當悔改歸向神，信入我們的主耶穌。
refs.text_en: Solemnly testifying both to Jews and to Greeks repentance unto God and faith in our Lord Jesus.

refs.text_gb: 且知道人得称义，不是本于行律法，乃是借着信耶稣基督，连我们也信入了基督耶稣，使我们本于信基督得称义，不是本于行律法；因为凡属肉体的人，都不能本于行律法得称义。
refs.text_big5: 且知道人得稱義，不是本於行律法，乃是藉著信耶穌基督，連我們也信入了基督耶穌，使我們本於信基督得稱義，不是本於行律法；因為凡屬肉體的人，都不能本於行律法得稱義。
refs.text_en: And knowing that a man is not justified out of works of law, but through faith in Jesus Christ, we also have believed into Christ Jesus that we might be justified out of faith in Christ and not out of the works of law, because out of the works of law no flesh will be justified.

verses.text_gb: 保罗[Fn1]讲论[Fn2][Cra]公义、[Crb]节制、和将来的[Crc]审判，腓力斯感到惧怕，就说，你暂且去吧，等我得便[Crd]再叫你来。
verses.text_big5: 保羅[Fn1]講論[Fn2][Cra]公義、[Crb]節制、和將來的[Crc]審判，腓力斯感到懼怕，就說，你暫且去罷，等我得便[Crd]再叫你來。
verses.text_en: And as he was reasoning concerning righteousness and self-control and the judgment to come, Felix became afraid and answered, Go for the present, and when I have an opportunity, I will call for you;
verses.text_gb_plain: 保罗讲论公义、节制、和将来的审判，腓力斯感到惧怕，就说，你暂且去吧，等我得便再叫你来。
verses.text_big5_plain: 保羅講論公義、節制、和將來的審判，腓力斯感到懼怕，就說，你暫且去罷，等我得便再叫你來。

footnotes.zh: 直译，透彻的讲论，(在辩论或劝勉中)讨论，争辩。与十七2，十八4、19者同。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，透徹的講論，（在辯論或勸勉中）討論，爭辯。與十七2，十八4、19者同。
footnotes.en: 24:25 1 reasoning Lit., saying thoroughly, discussing (in argument or exhortation), disputing. The same as in Acts 17:2; 18:4, 19.

footnotes.zh: 使徒晓得腓力斯的不义(26～27)与荒淫(见24注1)，就和他讲论公义和节制，就是节制邪情和私欲，这里特别是指节制性欲。将来的审判与不义之人的复活有关，这复活是使徒在15节所传讲的(见该处注1)。使徒也和腓力斯讲论将来的审判作为警告，使腓力斯感到惧怕。见十42注1，十七31注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 使徒曉得腓力斯的不義（26～27）與荒淫，（見24註1，）就和他講論公義和節制，就是節制邪情和私慾，這裏特別是指節制性慾。將來的審判與不義之人的復活有關，這復活是使徒在15節所傳講的。（見15註1。）使徒也和腓力斯講論將來的審判作為警告，使腓力斯感到懼怕。見十42註1，十七31註1。
footnotes.en: 24:25 2 righteousness Realizing Felix's unrighteousness (vv. 26-27) and intemperance (see note Acts 24:24 1 ) the apostle reasoned with Felix regarding righteousness and self-control, the control of passions and desires, especially, here, sexual desires. The coming judgment is related to the resurrection of the unrighteous, which the apostle preached in v. 15 (see note Acts 24:15 1 ). The apostle reasoned with Felix regarding the coming judgment also; this was a warning to Felix. Through this, Felix became afraid. See note Acts 10:42 1 and note Acts 17:31 1 .

refs.text_gb: 教导我们弃绝不敬虔和属世的情欲，好在今世过自守、公义、敬虔的生活，
refs.text_big5: 教導我們棄絕不敬虔和屬世的情慾，好在今世過自守、公義、敬虔的生活，
refs.text_en: Training us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in the present age,

refs.text_gb: 所以作监督的必须无可指责，只作一个妻子的丈夫，节制适度，清明自守，端正规矩，乐意待客，善于教导；
refs.text_big5: 所以作監督的必須無可指責，只作一個妻子的丈夫，節制適度，清明自守，端正規矩，樂意待客，善於教導；
refs.text_en: The overseer then must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, of a sober mind, orderly, hospitable, apt to teach;

refs.text_gb: 在知识上供应节制，在节制上供应忍耐，在忍耐上供应敬虔，
refs.text_big5: 在知識上供應節制，在節制上供應忍耐，在忍耐上供應敬虔，
refs.text_en: And in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, endurance; and in endurance, godliness;

crossrefs.label: c
crossrefs.raw: 罗二2～3，5，16，提后四1，彼前四5，启二十12

refs.text_gb: 我们知道行这样事的人，神必按真理审判他。
refs.text_big5: 我們知道行這樣事的人，神必按真理審判他。
refs.text_en: But we know that the judgment of God is according to truth upon those who practice such things.

refs.text_gb: 人哪，你审判行这样事的人，自己却照样行，你以为能逃脱神的审判么？
refs.text_big5: 人哪，你審判行這樣事的人，自己卻照樣行，你以為能逃脫神的審判麼？
refs.text_en: And do you consider this, O man, who judge those who practice such things and do the same yourself, that you will escape the judgment of God?

refs.text_gb: 你竟任着你刚硬不悔改的心，为自己在神动怒并显示祂公义审判的日子，积蓄忿怒。
refs.text_big5: 你竟任著你剛硬不悔改的心，為自己在神動怒並顯示祂公義審判的日子，積蓄忿怒。
refs.text_en: But, according to your hardness and your unrepentant heart, you are storing up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God,

refs.text_gb: 就是在神借耶稣基督，照着我的福音，审判人隐秘事的日子。
refs.text_big5: 就是在神藉耶穌基督，照著我的福音，審判人隱祕事的日子。
refs.text_en: In the day when God judges the secrets of men according to my gospel through Jesus Christ.

refs.text_gb: 我在神并那将要审判活人死人的基督耶稣面前，凭着祂的显现和祂的国度，郑重地嘱咐你，
refs.text_big5: 我在神並那將要審判活人死人的基督耶穌面前，憑著祂的顯現和祂的國度，鄭重的囑咐你，
refs.text_en: I solemnly charge you before God and Christ Jesus, who is to judge the living and the dead, and by His appearing and His kingdom:

refs.text_gb: 他们必向那预备好要审判活人死人的主交账。
refs.text_big5: 他們必向那豫備好要審判活人死人的主交賬。
refs.text_en: Who will render an account to Him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

refs.text_gb: 我又看见死了的，无论大小，都站在宝座前。案卷展开了，并且另有一卷展开，就是生命册。死了的都凭着这些案卷所记载的，照他们所行的受审判。
refs.text_big5: 我又看見死了的，無論大小，都站在寶座前。案卷展開了，並且另有一卷展開，就是生命冊。死了的都憑著這些案卷所記載的，照他們所行的受審判。
refs.text_en: And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and scrolls were opened; and another scroll was opened, which is the book of life. And the dead were judged by the things which were written in the scrolls, according to their works.

refs.text_gb: 众人听见死人复活，就有讥诮他的，又有人说，我们还要再听你讲这个。
refs.text_big5: 眾人聽見死人復活，就有譏誚他的，又有人說，我們還要再聽你講這個。
refs.text_en: And when they heard of a resurrection of the dead, some scoffed; and others said, We will hear you yet again concerning this.

verses.text_gb: 同时腓力斯又指望保罗送[Fn1][Cra]钱给他，所以屡次打发人叫他来，和他谈论。
verses.text_big5: 同時腓力斯又指望保羅送[Fn1][Cra]錢給他，所以屢次打發人叫他來，和他談論。
verses.text_en: Hoping at the same time also that money would be given to him by Paul. Therefore he also sent for him more frequently and conversed with him.
verses.text_gb_plain: 同时腓力斯又指望保罗送钱给他，所以屡次打发人叫他来，和他谈论。
verses.text_big5_plain: 同時腓力斯又指望保羅送錢給他，所以屢次打發人叫他來，和他談論。

footnotes.zh: 这指明罗马政客的腐败。见二三1注3。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這指明羅馬政客的腐敗。見二三1註3。
footnotes.en: 24:26 1 money This indicated the Roman politician's corruption. See note Acts 23:1 3 .

refs.text_gb: 不可受贿赂，因为贿赂能叫明眼人变瞎了，又能颠倒义人的话。
refs.text_big5: 不可受賄賂，因為賄賂能叫明眼人變瞎了，又能顛倒義人的話。
refs.text_en: And you shall not take a bribe, for a bribe blinds those whose eyes are open and perverts the words of the righteous.

verses.text_gb: 过了[Fn1]两年，波求[Fn2][Cra]非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要[Fn3][Crb]讨好犹太人，就[Crc]留保罗在[Crd]捆锁中。
verses.text_big5: 過了[Fn1]兩年，波求[Fn2][Cra]非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要[Fn3][Crb]討好猶太人，就[Crc]留保羅在[Crd]捆鎖中。
verses.text_en: And when two years were completed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus; and wanting to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul bound.
verses.text_gb_plain: 过了两年，波求非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要讨好犹太人，就留保罗在捆锁中。
verses.text_big5_plain: 過了兩年，波求非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要討好猶太人，就留保羅在捆鎖中。

footnotes.zh: 路加并没有说出使徒这两年所作的。他也许利用这段时间，为着主在地上的行动，与主同在。若是这样，这也许影响了他在罗马上诉期间所写的书信——歌罗西、以弗所和腓立比，这些书信乃是神圣启示中最奥秘、最深奥且最丰富的。这些书信所带给历代召会的供应，是难以尽述的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 路加並沒有說出使徒這兩年所作的。他也許利用這段時間，為著主在地上的行動，與主同在。若是這樣，這也許影響了他在羅馬上訴期間所寫的書信─歌羅西、以弗所和腓立比，這些書信乃是神聖啟示中最奧祕、最深奧且最豐富的。這些書信所帶給歷代召會的供應，是難以盡述的。
footnotes.en: 24:27 1 two Luke does not disclose what the apostle did during these two years. He might have used the time to be with the Lord for His move on earth. If so, this might have influenced the Epistles he wrote during the time of his appeal in Rome — Colossians, Ephesians, and Philippians —; which are the most mysterious, most profound, and richest in the divine revelation. The supply that they have brought to the church throughout the generations cannot be fully told.

footnotes.zh: 接续腓力斯作犹太总督的人。
footnotes.zh_big5: 接續腓力斯作猶太總督的人。
footnotes.en: 24:27 2 Festus Felix's successor as the governor of Judea.

footnotes.zh: 直译，授惠给。意即授惠以受惠。这再一次显示罗马政治的腐败。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，授惠給。意即授惠以受惠。這再一次顯示羅馬政治的腐敗。
footnotes.en: 24:27 3 gain Lit., grant favor to; i.e., grant favor to gain favor. This again showed the corruption of Roman politics.

refs.text_gb: 非斯都到省上任，过了三天，就从该撒利亚上耶路撒冷去。
refs.text_big5: 非斯都到省上任，過了三天，就從該撒利亞上耶路撒冷去。
refs.text_en: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

refs.text_gb: 保罗这样分诉，非斯都大声说，保罗，你癫狂了，你的学问太大，反叫你癫狂了。
refs.text_big5: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說，保羅，你癲狂了，你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了。
refs.text_en: And as he was saying these things in his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, You are insane, Paul. Much learning is driving you insane.

footnotes.zh: 保罗乃是为着辩护，要上诉于该撒(见二二1注2，二六32注2)。这要实现他去罗马推广主见证的心愿(十九21)，也是照着主所指示他的(二三11)。保罗若不上诉于该撒，就会因犹太人的阴谋被杀(参二三12～15，二五1～3，9)，他就不能写最后的八封书信。保罗去罗马上诉于该撒之前，只写了六封书信：帖前、帖后、加拉太、罗马、林前、林后。他第一次监禁在罗马时，写了歌罗西、以弗所、腓立比和腓利门；出监以后，写了提前、提多和希伯来；第二次监禁时，写了提后。若没有末了这八封书信，神圣的启示会有何等的残缺，召会要受何等的损失！保罗的上诉，确实给主的权益带来莫大的利益和益处。
footnotes.zh_big5: 保羅乃是為著辯護，要上訴於該撒。（見二二1註2，二六32註2。）這要實現他去羅馬推廣主見證的心願，（十九21，）也是照著主所指示他的。（二三11。）保羅若不上訴於該撒，就會因猶太人的陰謀被殺，（參二三12～15，二五1～3，9，）他就不能寫最後的八封書信。保羅去羅馬上訴於該撒之前，只寫了六封書信：帖前、帖後、加拉太、羅馬、林前、林後。他第一次監禁在羅馬時，寫了歌羅西、以弗所、腓立比和腓利門；出監以後，寫了提前、提多和希伯來；第二次監禁時，寫了提後。若沒有末了這八封書信，神聖的啟示會有何等的殘缺，召會要受何等的損失！保羅的上訴，確實給主的權益帶來莫大的利益和益處。
footnotes.en: 25:11 1 appeal For his defense Paul wanted to appeal to Caesar (see note Acts 22:1 2 and note Acts 26:32 2 ). This would allow him to fulfill his desire to see Rome for the furtherance of the Lord's testimony (Acts 19:21) and was according to the Lord's indication to him (Acts 23:11). Without this appeal he would have been killed by the Jews who plotted against him (cf. Acts 23:12-15; 25:1-3, 9) and would not have been able to write his last eight Epistles. Before his appeal to Rome, he had written only six Epistles: 1 and 2 Thessalonians, Galatians, Romans, and 1 and 2 Corinthians. During his first imprisonment in Rome he wrote Colossians, Ephesians, Philippians, and Philemon. After that imprisonment he wrote 1 Timothy, Titus, and Hebrews. Then, during his second imprisonment he wrote 2 Timothy. Without these last eight Epistles, what a lack the divine revelation would have and what a loss the church would have suffered! His appeal did render great profit and benefit to the Lord's interest.

verses.text_en: And Agrippa said to Paul, You are permitted to speak for yourself. Then Paul stretched out his hand and made his defense:
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚基帕对保罗说，准你为自己申诉。于是保罗伸手分诉说，
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞基帕對保羅說，准你為自己申訴。於是保羅伸手分訴說，

refs.text_gb: 总督点头叫保罗说话，他就回答说，我知道你在这国里审案多年，所以我乐意为自己的事分诉。
refs.text_big5: 總督點頭叫保羅說話，他就回答說，我知道你在這國裏審案多年，所以我樂意為自己的事分訴。
refs.text_en: And when the governor nodded for him to speak, Paul answered: Knowing that for many years you have been a judge to this nation, I gladly make my defense for the things concerning myself,

refs.text_gb: 保罗分诉说，无论犹太人的律法，或是圣殿，或是该撒，我都没有得罪过。
refs.text_big5: 保羅分訴說，無論猶太人的律法，或是聖殿，或是該撒，我都沒有得罪過。
refs.text_en: While Paul said in his defense, Neither against the law of the Jews nor against the temple nor against Caesar have I sinned in anything.

verses.text_gb: [Cra]亚基帕王啊，犹太人[Crb]控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前[Fn1]分诉，乃为有幸；
verses.text_big5: [Cra]亞基帕王阿，猶太人[Crb]控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前[Fn1]分訴，乃為有幸；
verses.text_en: Concerning all the things which I am accused of by the Jews, King Agrippa, I consider myself blessed that I am to make my defense before you today,
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚基帕王啊，犹太人控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分诉，乃为有幸；
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞基帕王阿，猶太人控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分訴，乃為有幸；

footnotes.zh: 见二二1注2。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見二二1註2。
footnotes.en: 26:2 1 defense See note Acts 22:1 2 .

refs.text_gb: 主却对亚拿尼亚说，你只管去，因为这人是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王并以色列子孙面前，宣扬我的名；
refs.text_big5: 主卻對亞拿尼亞說，你只管去，因為這人是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王並以色列子孫面前，宣揚我的名；
refs.text_en: But the Lord said to him, Go, for this man is a chosen vessel to Me, to bear My name before both the Gentiles and kings and the sons of Israel;

refs.text_gb: 这应许，我们十二个支派昼夜切切地事奉神，都盼望得着；王啊，我被犹太人控告，就是因这盼望。
refs.text_big5: 這應許，我們十二個支派晝夜切切的事奉神，都盼望得著；王阿，我被猶太人控告，就是因這盼望。
refs.text_en: To which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, O king.

refs.text_gb: 我回答他们说，无论什么人，被告还没有和原告当面对质，未得机会分诉所告他的事，就先把他交给对方，这不是罗马人的规例。
refs.text_big5: 我回答他們說，無論甚麼人，被告還沒有和原告當面對質，未得機會分訴所告他的事，就先把他交給對方，這不是羅馬人的規例。
refs.text_en: To them I answered that it is not the custom with Romans to hand over any man before he who is accused meets the accusers face to face and has an opportunity for a defense concerning the charge.

verses.text_gb: [Fn1]尤其你熟悉犹太人的一切[Cra]规例，和他们的[Crb]问题，所以求你耐心听我。
verses.text_big5: [Fn1]尤其你熟悉猶太人的一切[Cra]規例，和他們的[Crb]問題，所以求你耐心聽我。
verses.text_en: Especially since you are familiar with all the customs and questions among the Jews; therefore I beg you to listen to me patiently.
verses.text_gb_plain: 尤其你熟悉犹太人的一切规例，和他们的问题，所以求你耐心听我。
verses.text_big5_plain: 尤其你熟悉猶太人的一切規例，和他們的問題，所以求你耐心聽我。

footnotes.zh: 或，既然你特别专精于。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，既然你特別專精於。
footnotes.en: 26:3 1 Especially Or, Since you are especially expert in.

refs.text_gb: 我们曾听见他说，这拿撒勒人耶稣要毁坏此地，也要改变摩西所交给我们的规例。
refs.text_big5: 我們曾聽見他說，這拿撒勒人耶穌要毀壞此地，也要改變摩西所交給我們的規例。
refs.text_en: For we have heard him saying that this Jesus the Nazarene will destroy this place and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.

refs.text_gb: 不过是和保罗争论一些他们自己敬鬼神的问题，又关于一位已经死了的耶稣，保罗断言祂是活着的。
refs.text_big5: 不過是和保羅爭論一些他們自己敬鬼神的問題，又關於一位已經死了的耶穌，保羅斷言祂是活著的。
refs.text_en: But they had certain questions against him concerning their own religion and concerning a certain Jesus who had died, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

verses.text_gb: 我从起初在本[Cra]国的民中，并在耶路撒冷，自幼为人如何，犹太人都知道。
verses.text_big5: 我從起初在本[Cra]國的民中，並在耶路撒冷，自幼為人如何，猶太人都知道。
verses.text_en: The manner of my life from youth, which from the beginning was among my own nation and in Jerusalem, all the Jews know,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我从起初在本国的民中，并在耶路撒冷，自幼为人如何，犹太人都知道。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我從起初在本國的民中，並在耶路撒冷，自幼為人如何，猶太人都知道。

refs.text_gb: 过了几年，我上去周济我本国的百姓，并献供物，
refs.text_big5: 過了幾年，我上去賙濟我本國的百姓，並獻供物，
refs.text_en: Now after many years I came bringing alms to my nation and offerings;

refs.text_gb: 无奈犹太人不服，我才被迫上诉于该撒，并非有什么事要控告我本国的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 無奈猶太人不服，我纔被迫上訴於該撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。
refs.text_en: But when the Jews spoke against this, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar, not that I have anything to accuse my nation of.

verses.text_gb: 他们若肯作见证，他们从起初早就晓得，我是按着我们[Fn1]宗教最[Cra]严紧的[Crb]教派，作了[Crc]法利赛人。
verses.text_big5: 他們若肯作見證，他們從起初早就曉得，我是按著我們[Fn1]宗教最[Cra]嚴緊的[Crb]教派，作了[Crc]法利賽人。
verses.text_en: Since they have previously known about me from the first, if they were willing to testify, that according to the strictest sect of our religion I lived as a Pharisee.
verses.text_gb_plain: 他们若肯作见证，他们从起初早就晓得，我是按着我们宗教最严紧的教派，作了法利赛人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 他們若肯作見證，他們從起初早就曉得，我是按著我們宗教最嚴緊的教派，作了法利賽人。

footnotes.zh: 宗教，或，热心拜神。见雅一26注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 宗教，或，熱心拜神。見雅一26註1。
footnotes.en: 26:5 1 religion Or, zealous worship to God. See note James 1:26 1 .

refs.text_gb: 保罗说，我是犹太人，生在基利家的大数，在这城里长大，在迦玛列脚前，按着我们祖宗严紧的律法受教，我为神热心，像你们众人今日一样。
refs.text_big5: 保羅說，我是猶太人，生在基利家的大數，在這城裏長大，在迦瑪列腳前，按著我們祖宗嚴緊的律法受教，我為神熱心，像你們眾人今日一樣。
refs.text_en: I am a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia but brought up in this city and trained at the feet of Gamaliel, according to the strictness of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

refs.text_gb: 唯有几个信徒原是法利赛派的人，起来说，必须给外邦人行割礼，嘱咐他们遵守摩西的律法。
refs.text_big5: 惟有幾個信徒原是法利賽派的人，起來說，必須給外邦人行割禮，囑咐他們遵守摩西的律法。
refs.text_en: But certain men from the sect of the Pharisees who had believed rose up from among them, saying, It is necessary to circumcise them and to charge them to keep the law of Moses.

refs.text_gb: 保罗看出其中一部分是撒都该人，另一部分是法利赛人，就在议会中喊着说，诸位，弟兄们，我是法利赛人，是法利赛人的子孙；我现在受审问，是为了盼望死人复活。
refs.text_big5: 保羅看出其中一部分是撒都該人，另一部分是法利賽人，就在議會中喊著說，諸位，弟兄們，我是法利賽人，是法利賽人的子孫；我現在受審問，是為了盼望死人復活。
refs.text_en: And Paul, knowing that one part was Sadducees and the other Pharisees, cried out in the Sanhedrin, Men, brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees; concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!

verses.text_gb: 现在我站着受审，是因为[Cra]盼望神向我们祖宗所应许的；
verses.text_big5: 現在我站著受審，是因為[Cra]盼望神向我們祖宗所應許的；
verses.text_en: And now I stand here being judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,
verses.text_gb_plain: 现在我站着受审，是因为盼望神向我们祖宗所应许的；
verses.text_big5_plain: 現在我站著受審，是因為盼望神向我們祖宗所應許的；

refs.text_gb: 保罗看出其中一部分是撒都该人，另一部分是法利赛人，就在议会中喊着说，诸位，弟兄们，我是法利赛人，是法利赛人的子孙；我现在受审问，是为了盼望死人复活。
refs.text_big5: 保羅看出其中一部分是撒都該人，另一部分是法利賽人，就在議會中喊著說，諸位，弟兄們，我是法利賽人，是法利賽人的子孫；我現在受審問，是為了盼望死人復活。
refs.text_en: And Paul, knowing that one part was Sadducees and the other Pharisees, cried out in the Sanhedrin, Men, brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees; concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!

refs.text_gb: 我向神存着盼望，无论义的和不义的都要复活，就是他们自己也是这样盼望。
refs.text_big5: 我向神存著盼望，無論義的和不義的都要復活，就是他們自己也是這樣盼望。
refs.text_en: Having hope toward God, which these themselves also look for, that there is to be a resurrection of both the righteous and the unrighteous.

refs.text_gb: 为这缘故，我恳求你们来见面谈论；我原是为了以色列所盼望的，才戴上这锁链。
refs.text_big5: 為這緣故，我懇求你們來見面談論；我原是為了以色列所盼望的，纔戴上這鎖鍊。
refs.text_en: For this cause therefore, I have entreated you to see me and speak with me; for on account of the hope of Israel I have this chain around me.

verses.text_gb: 这应许，我们[Cra]十二个支派[Crb]昼夜切切地事奉神，都盼望得着；王啊，我被犹太人[Crc]控告，就是因这盼望。
verses.text_big5: 這應許，我們[Cra]十二個支派[Crb]晝夜切切的事奉神，都盼望得著；王阿，我被猶太人[Crc]控告，就是因這盼望。
verses.text_en: To which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, O king.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这应许，我们十二个支派昼夜切切地事奉神，都盼望得着；王啊，我被犹太人控告，就是因这盼望。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這應許，我們十二個支派晝夜切切的事奉神，都盼望得著；王阿，我被猶太人控告，就是因這盼望。

refs.text_gb: 耶稣就对他们说，我实在告诉你们，你们这些跟从过我的人，在复兴的时候，当人子坐在祂荣耀的宝座上，你们也要坐在十二个宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌就對他們說，我實在告訴你們，你們這些跟從過我的人，在復興的時候，當人子坐在祂榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
refs.text_en: And Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you that you who have followed Me, in the restoration, when the Son of Man sits on the throne of His glory, you also shall sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

refs.text_gb: 神和主耶稣基督的奴仆雅各，写信给散居的十二个支派：愿你们喜乐。
refs.text_big5: 神和主耶穌基督的奴僕雅各，寫信給散居的十二個支派：願你們喜樂。
refs.text_en: James, a slave of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes in the dispersion: Rejoice!

refs.text_gb: 就寡居到八十四岁，并不离开圣殿，禁食祈求，昼夜事奉神。
refs.text_big5: 就寡居到八十四歲，並不離開聖殿，禁食祈求，晝夜事奉神。
refs.text_en: And she was a widow up to the age of eighty-four, who did not depart from the temple, serving God with fastings and petitions night and day.

refs.text_gb: 亚基帕王啊，犹太人控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分诉，乃为有幸；
refs.text_big5: 亞基帕王阿，猶太人控告我的一切事，今日得在你面前分訴，乃為有幸；
refs.text_en: Concerning all the things which I am accused of by the Jews, King Agrippa, I consider myself blessed that I am to make my defense before you today,

verses.text_gb: 神既叫死人[Cra]复活，你们为什么断为不可信的？
verses.text_big5: 神既叫死人[Cra]復活，你們為甚麼斷為不可信的？
verses.text_en: Why is it judged incredible among you if God raises the dead?
verses.text_gb_plain: 神既叫死人复活，你们为什么断为不可信的？
verses.text_big5_plain: 神既叫死人復活，你們為甚麼斷為不可信的？

refs.text_gb: 神却将死的痛苦解除，叫祂复活了，因为祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_big5: 神卻將死的痛苦解除，叫祂復活了，因為祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_en: Whom God has raised up, having loosed the pangs of death, since it was not possible for Him to be held by it.

refs.text_gb: 既传基督从死人中复活了，怎么在你们中间，有人说没有死人的复活？
refs.text_big5: 既傳基督從死人中復活了，怎麼在你們中間，有人說沒有死人的復活？
refs.text_en: But if Christ is proclaimed that He has been raised from the dead, how is it that some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.text_gb: 从前我自己也以为，应当多方[Cra]攻击[Crb]拿撒勒人耶稣的名。
verses.text_big5: 從前我自己也以為，應當多方[Cra]攻擊[Crb]拿撒勒人耶穌的名。
verses.text_en: Well then, I thought to myself that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus the Nazarene,
verses.text_gb_plain: 从前我自己也以为，应当多方攻击拿撒勒人耶稣的名。
verses.text_big5_plain: 從前我自己也以為，應當多方攻擊拿撒勒人耶穌的名。

refs.text_gb: 我从前是亵渎神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了怜悯，因我是在不信中，无知而作的。
refs.text_big5: 我從前是褻瀆神的、逼迫人的、侮慢人的；然而我蒙了憐憫，因我是在不信中，無知而作的。
refs.text_en: Who formerly was a blasphemer and a persecutor and an insulting person; but I was shown mercy because, being ignorant, I acted in unbelief.

refs.text_gb: 我回答说，主啊，你是谁？祂对我说，我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 我回答說，主阿，你是誰？祂對我說，我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶穌。
refs.text_en: And I answered, Who are You, Lord? And He said to me, I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you persecute.

verses.text_gb: 我在耶路撒冷就曾这样行了；既从祭司长得了[Cra]权柄，我就把许多圣徒囚在[Crb]监里，并且他们被杀，我也[Crc]投票定罪。
verses.text_big5: 我在耶路撒冷就曾這樣行了；既從祭司長得了[Cra]權柄，我就把許多聖徒囚在[Crb]監裏，並且他們被殺，我也[Crc]投票定罪。
verses.text_en: Which also I did in Jerusalem; and I both shut up many of the saints in prison when I had received authority from the chief priests and cast a vote against them when they were being done away with.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我在耶路撒冷就曾这样行了；既从祭司长得了权柄，我就把许多圣徒囚在监里，并且他们被杀，我也投票定罪。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我在耶路撒冷就曾這樣行了；既從祭司長得了權柄，我就把許多聖徒囚在監裏，並且他們被殺，我也投票定罪。

refs.text_gb: 并且他在这里有从祭司长得来的权柄，要捆绑一切呼求你名的人。
refs.text_big5: 並且他在這裏有從祭司長得來的權柄，要捆綁一切呼求你名的人。
refs.text_en: And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call upon Your name.

refs.text_gb: 扫罗却残害召会，逐家进去，连男带女拉去下在监里。
refs.text_big5: 掃羅卻殘害召會，逐家進去，連男帶女拉去下在監裏。
refs.text_en: But Saul was devastating the church, entering house after house; and dragging off men and women, he delivered them to prison.

refs.text_gb: 我就说，主啊，他们知道我从前把信靠你的人收在监里，又在各会堂里鞭打他们，
refs.text_big5: 我就說，主阿，他們知道我從前把信靠你的人收在監裏，又在各會堂裏鞭打他們，
refs.text_en: And I said, Lord, they know that I was imprisoning and beating from synagogue to synagogue those who believe on You;

refs.text_gb: 又跪下，大声喊着说，主啊，不要将这罪归与他们！说了这话，就睡了。扫罗也赞同他被杀。
refs.text_big5: 又跪下，大聲喊著說，主阿，不要將這罪歸與他們！說了這話，就睡了。掃羅也贊同他被殺。
refs.text_en: And kneeling down, he cried out with a loud voice, Lord, do not hold this sin against them. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.

refs.text_gb: 并且你的见证人司提反遇害流血的时候，我还亲自站在旁边，予以赞同，并且看守害死他之人的衣服。
refs.text_big5: 並且你的見證人司提反遇害流血的時候，我還親自站在旁邊，予以贊同，並且看守害死他之人的衣服。
refs.text_en: And when the blood of Your witness Stephen was being shed, I myself also was standing by and approving and keeping the garments of those who did away with him.

verses.text_gb: 在各[Cra]会堂，我屡次用刑，想强逼他们说亵渎的话，又格外恼恨他们，甚至[Crb]追逼他们，直到[Fn1]外邦的城邑。
verses.text_big5: 在各[Cra]會堂，我屢次用刑，想強逼他們說褻瀆的話，又格外惱恨他們，甚至[Crb]追逼他們，直到[Fn1]外邦的城邑。
verses.text_en: And in all the synagogues I punished them often and tried to compel them to blaspheme; and being exceedingly enraged at them, I persecuted them even as far as foreign cities.
verses.text_gb_plain: 在各会堂，我屡次用刑，想强逼他们说亵渎的话，又格外恼恨他们，甚至追逼他们，直到外邦的城邑。
verses.text_big5_plain: 在各會堂，我屢次用刑，想強逼他們說褻瀆的話，又格外惱恨他們，甚至追逼他們，直到外邦的城邑。

footnotes.zh: 直译，外面。
footnotes.zh_big5: 直譯，外面。
footnotes.en: 26:11 1 foreign Lit., outside.

refs.text_gb: 我就说，主啊，他们知道我从前把信靠你的人收在监里，又在各会堂里鞭打他们，
refs.text_big5: 我就說，主阿，他們知道我從前把信靠你的人收在監裏，又在各會堂裏鞭打他們，
refs.text_en: And I said, Lord, they know that I was imprisoning and beating from synagogue to synagogue those who believe on You;

refs.text_gb: 就在那日，在耶路撒冷的召会大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，门徒都分散在犹太和撒玛利亚各地。
refs.text_big5: 就在那日，在耶路撒冷的召會大遭逼迫，除了使徒以外，門徒都分散在猶太和撒瑪利亞各地。
refs.text_en: And Saul approved of his killing. And there occurred in that day a great persecution against the church which was in Jerusalem; and all were scattered throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except the apostles.

refs.text_gb: 你们听过我从前在犹太教中所行的事，怎样极力逼迫神的召会，并损毁神的召会。
refs.text_big5: 你們聽過我從前在猶太教中所行的事，怎樣極力逼迫神的召會，並損毀神的召會。
refs.text_en: For you have heard of my manner of life formerly in Judaism, that I persecuted the church of God excessively and ravaged it.

verses.text_gb: 那时，我领了祭司长的权柄和使命，[Cra]往大马色去。
verses.text_big5: 那時，我領了祭司長的權柄和使命，[Cra]往大馬色去。
verses.text_en: Engaged in these things, I journeyed to Damascus with authority and a commission from the chief priests.
verses.text_gb_plain: 那时，我领了祭司长的权柄和使命，往大马色去。
verses.text_big5_plain: 那時，我領了祭司長的權柄和使命，往大馬色去。

refs.text_gb: 扫罗行路，将近大马色，忽然有光从天上四面照着他，
refs.text_big5: 掃羅行路，將近大馬色，忽然有光從天上四面照著他，
refs.text_en: And as he went, he drew near to Damascus, and suddenly a light from heaven flashed around him.

refs.text_gb: 他就仆倒在地，听见有声音对他说，扫罗，扫罗，你为什么逼迫我？
refs.text_big5: 他就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對他說，掃羅，掃羅，你為甚麼逼迫我？
refs.text_en: And he fell on the ground and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?

refs.text_gb: 他说，主啊，你是谁？主说，我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 他說，主阿，你是誰？主說，我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
refs.text_en: And he said, Who are You, Lord? And He said, I am Jesus, whom you persecute.

refs.text_gb: 起来，进城去，你所当作的事，必有人告诉你。
refs.text_big5: 起來，進城去，你所當作的事，必有人告訴你。
refs.text_en: But rise up and enter into the city, and it will be told to you what you must do.

refs.text_gb: 与他同行的人站着，说不出话来，听见声音，却看不见人。
refs.text_big5: 與他同行的人站著，說不出話來，聽見聲音，卻看不見人。
refs.text_en: And the men who journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing the voice but seeing no one.

refs.text_gb: 扫罗从地上起来，睁开眼睛，竟不能看见什么；有人拉着他的手，领他进了大马色。
refs.text_big5: 掃羅從地上起來，睜開眼睛，竟不能看見甚麼；有人拉著他的手，領他進了大馬色。
refs.text_en: And Saul rose from the ground; and though his eyes were open, he could see nothing. And they led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

refs.text_gb: 我将到大马色，正走的时候，约在中午，忽然从天上发出大光，四面照着我，
refs.text_big5: 我將到大馬色，正走的時候，約在中午，忽然從天上發出大光，四面照著我，
refs.text_en: And as I journeyed and drew near to Damascus about midday, suddenly a great light flashed out of heaven around me;

refs.text_gb: 我就仆倒在地，听见有声音对我说，扫罗，扫罗，你为什么逼迫我？
refs.text_big5: 我就仆倒在地，聽見有聲音對我說，掃羅，掃羅，你為甚麼逼迫我？
refs.text_en: And I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me?

refs.text_gb: 我回答说，主啊，你是谁？祂对我说，我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶稣。
refs.text_big5: 我回答說，主阿，你是誰？祂對我說，我就是你所逼迫的拿撒勒人耶穌。
refs.text_en: And I answered, Who are You, Lord? And He said to me, I am Jesus the Nazarene, whom you persecute.

refs.text_gb: 与我同行的人看见了那光，却没有听明那对我说话者的声音。
refs.text_big5: 與我同行的人看見了那光，卻沒有聽明那對我說話者的聲音。
refs.text_en: And those who were with me beheld the light, but did not hear the voice of the One who was speaking to me.

refs.text_gb: 我说，主啊，我当作什么？主对我说，起来，进大马色去，在那里要将所派你作的一切事都告诉你。
refs.text_big5: 我說，主阿，我當作甚麼？主對我說，起來，進大馬色去，在那裏要將所派你作的一切事都告訴你。
refs.text_en: And I said, What shall I do, Lord? And the Lord said to me, Rise up and go into Damascus, and there it will be told to you concerning all the things which have been appointed to you to do.

refs.text_gb: 我因那光的荣耀，不能看见，就由同行的人牵着我的手，进了大马色。
refs.text_big5: 我因那光的榮耀，不能看見，就由同行的人牽著我的手，進了大馬色。
refs.text_en: And as I could not see because of the glory of that light, I was led by the hand by those who were with me and came into Damascus.

verses.text_gb: 王啊，正午的时候，我在路上看见一道光，比日头还亮，从天上四面照着我和与我同行的人。
verses.text_big5: 王阿，正午的時候，我在路上看見一道光，比日頭還亮，從天上四面照著我和與我同行的人。
verses.text_en: At midday, on the way, I saw, O King, a light from heaven beyond the brightness of the sun, shining around me and those who journeyed with me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王啊，正午的时候，我在路上看见一道光，比日头还亮，从天上四面照着我和与我同行的人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王阿，正午的時候，我在路上看見一道光，比日頭還亮，從天上四面照著我和與我同行的人。

verses.text_gb: 我们都仆倒在地上，我就听见有声音，用[Cra]希伯来语向我说，扫罗，扫罗，你为什么逼迫[Fn1]我？你踢[Fn2]犁棒是难的。
verses.text_big5: 我們都仆倒在地上，我就聽見有聲音，用[Cra]希伯來語向我說，掃羅，掃羅，你為甚麼逼迫[Fn1]我？你踢[Fn2]犁棒是難的。
verses.text_en: And when we all fell to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew dialect, Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我们都仆倒在地上，我就听见有声音，用希伯来语向我说，扫罗，扫罗，你为什么逼迫我？你踢犁棒是难的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我們都仆倒在地上，我就聽見有聲音，用希伯來語向我說，掃羅，掃羅，你為甚麼逼迫我？你踢犁棒是難的。

footnotes.zh: 见九4注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見九4註1。
footnotes.en: 26:14 1 Me See note Acts 9:4 1 .

footnotes.zh: 犁上的刺棒，为制伏、驱使套在犁上的牲畜用者。主这话表明扫罗已经被套在主的犁上了，他只好乖乖地负主的轭，完成主的使命。他想要踢主犁上的刺棒是难的。
footnotes.zh_big5: 犁上的刺棒，為制伏、驅使套在犁上的牲畜用者。主這話表明掃羅已經被套在主的犁上了，他只好乖乖的負主的軛，完成主的使命。他想要踢主犁上的刺棒是難的。
footnotes.en: 26:14 2 goads A goad on a plow is a sharp-pointed stick used to subdue and prod an ox yoked to the plow. The Lord's word here signifies that Saul was already yoked to the plow and had no choice but to take the Lord's yoke obediently for the carrying out of the Lord's commission. It was hard for him to kick against the goads on the Lord's plow.

refs.text_gb: 千夫长准了，保罗就站在台阶上，向百姓摆手，他们都静默无声，保罗便用希伯来语对他们讲话，说：
refs.text_big5: 千夫長准了，保羅就站在臺階上，向百姓擺手，他們都靜默無聲，保羅便用希伯來語對他們講話，說：
refs.text_en: And when he had given him permission, Paul stood on the stairs and motioned with his hand to the people. And when there was a great silence, he addressed them in the Hebrew dialect, saying,

refs.text_gb: 众人听见他用希伯来语对他们讲话，就更加安静了。
refs.text_big5: 眾人聽見他用希伯來語對他們講話，就更加安靜了。
refs.text_en: And when they heard that he addressed them in the Hebrew dialect, they became more quiet. And he said,

verses.text_gb: 我说，[Fn1]主啊，你是谁？主说，我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
verses.text_big5: 我說，[Fn1]主阿，你是誰？主說，我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。
verses.text_en: And I said, Who are You, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus, whom you persecute.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我说，主啊，你是谁？主说，我就是你所逼迫的耶稣。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我說，主阿，你是誰？主說，我就是你所逼迫的耶穌。

footnotes.zh: 见九5注1。
footnotes.zh_big5: 見九5註1。
footnotes.en: 26:15 1 Lord See note note Acts 9:5 1 .

verses.text_gb: 你起来站着，我向你显现，正是要[Cra]选定你作执事和[Fn1][Crb]见证人，将你所[Crc]看见我的事，和我将要显现给你的事，见证出来；
verses.text_big5: 你起來站著，我向你顯現，正是要[Cra]選定你作執事和[Fn1][Crb]見證人，將你所[Crc]看見我的事，和我將要顯現給你的事，見證出來；
verses.text_en: But rise up and stand on your feet; for I have appeared to you for this purpose, to appoint you as a minister and a witness both of the things in which you have seen Me and of the things in which I will appear to you;
verses.text_gb_plain: 你起来站着，我向你显现，正是要选定你作执事和见证人，将你所看见我的事，和我将要显现给你的事，见证出来；
verses.text_big5_plain: 你起來站著，我向你顯現，正是要選定你作執事和見證人，將你所看見我的事，和我將要顯現給你的事，見證出來；

footnotes.zh: 不仅是执事，也是见证人。执事是为着职事，见证人是为着见证。职事主要的与工作有关，与执事的所作有关；见证与人有关，与见证人的所是有关(见一8注4，二三11注5)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 不僅是執事，也是見證人。執事是為著職事，見證人是為著見證。職事主要的與工作有關，與執事的所作有關；見證與人有關，與見證人的所是有關。（見一8註4，二三11註5。）
footnotes.en: 26:16 1 witness Not only a minister but also a witness. A minister is for the ministry; a witness, for the testimony. The ministry is related mainly to the work, to what a minister does; a testimony is related to the person, to what a witness is (see note Acts 1:8 3 and note Acts 23:11 4 ).

refs.text_gb: 他又说，我们祖宗的神预先选定了你，叫你认识祂的旨意，又得见那义者，且得听祂口中所出的声音；
refs.text_big5: 他又說，我們祖宗的神豫先選定了你，叫你認識祂的旨意，又得見那義者，且得聽祂口中所出的聲音；
refs.text_en: And he said, The God of our fathers has previously appointed you to know His will and to see the righteous One and to hear the voice from His mouth;

refs.text_gb: 但圣灵降临在你们身上，你们就必得着能力，并要在耶路撒冷、犹太全地、撒玛利亚，直到地极，作我的见证人。
refs.text_big5: 但聖靈降臨在你們身上，你們就必得著能力，並要在耶路撒冷、猶太全地、撒瑪利亞，直到地極，作我的見證人。
refs.text_en: But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you, and you shall be My witnesses both in Jerusalem and in all Judea and Samaria and unto the uttermost part of the earth.

refs.text_gb: 因为你要将所看见所听见的，向万人为祂作见证。
refs.text_big5: 因為你要將所看見所聽見的，向萬人為祂作見證。
refs.text_en: For you will be a witness to Him unto all men of the things which you have seen and heard.

verses.text_gb: 我要拯救你[Cra]脱离百姓和[Crb]外邦人。
verses.text_big5: 我要拯救你[Cra]脫離百姓和[Crb]外邦人。
verses.text_en: Delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,
verses.text_gb_plain: 我要拯救你脱离百姓和外邦人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我要拯救你脫離百姓和外邦人。

refs.text_gb: 彼得清醒过来，说，我现在真知道主差遣祂的使者，救我脱离希律的手，和犹太百姓一切所期待的。
refs.text_big5: 彼得清醒過來，說，我現在真知道主差遣祂的使者，救我脫離希律的手，和猶太百姓一切所期待的。
refs.text_en: And Peter came to himself and said, Now I know truly that the Lord has sent forth His angel and rescued me out of Herod's hand and from all the expectation of the Jewish people.

refs.text_gb: 主却对亚拿尼亚说，你只管去，因为这人是我所拣选的器皿，要在外邦人和君王并以色列子孙面前，宣扬我的名；
refs.text_big5: 主卻對亞拿尼亞說，你只管去，因為這人是我所揀選的器皿，要在外邦人和君王並以色列子孫面前，宣揚我的名；
refs.text_en: But the Lord said to him, Go, for this man is a chosen vessel to Me, to bear My name before both the Gentiles and kings and the sons of Israel;

refs.text_gb: 我是对你们外邦人说的，因我是外邦人的使徒，所以荣耀我的职事，
refs.text_big5: 我是對你們外邦人說的，因我是外邦人的使徒，所以榮耀我的職事，
refs.text_en: But I am speaking to you, the Gentiles. Inasmuch therefore as I am an apostle of the Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

verses.text_gb: 我差你到他们那里去，[Fn1]叫他们的[Cra]眼睛得开，从[Fn2][Crb]黑暗转入[Crc]光中，从[Fn3]撒但权下[Fn4]转向神，又因信入我，得蒙[Fn5][Crd]赦[Fn6]罪，并在一切[Fn7]圣别的人中得着[Fn8][Cre]基业。
verses.text_big5: 我差你到他們那裏去，[Fn1]叫他們的[Cra]眼睛得開，從[Fn2][Crb]黑暗轉入[Crc]光中，從[Fn3]撒但權下[Fn4]轉向神，又因信入我，得蒙[Fn5][Crd]赦[Fn6]罪，並在一切[Fn7]聖別的人中得著[Fn8][Cre]基業。
verses.text_en: To open their eyes, to turn them from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.
verses.text_gb_plain: 我差你到他们那里去，叫他们的眼睛得开，从黑暗转入光中，从撒但权下转向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，并在一切圣别的人中得着基业。
verses.text_big5_plain: 我差你到他們那裏去，叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗轉入光中，從撒但權下轉向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，並在一切聖別的人中得著基業。

footnotes.zh: 这是要实现神的禧年，主悦纳人的禧年，就是主耶稣在路四18～21照着神新约的经纶所宣扬的(见路四19注1)。新约禧年属灵和神圣的福分，也就是神福音的福分，其中第一项是叫堕落的人眼睛得开，从黑暗转入光中，使他们能在属灵的范围里看见神圣的事。要看见这些事，需要属灵的视力和神圣的光。
footnotes.zh_big5: 這是要實現神的禧年，主悅納人的禧年，就是主耶穌在路四18～21照著神新約的經綸所宣揚的。（見路四19註1。）新約禧年屬靈和神聖的福分，也就是神福音的福分，其中第一項是叫墮落的人眼睛得開，從黑暗轉入光中，使他們能在屬靈的範圍裏看見神聖的事。要看見這些事，需要屬靈的視力和神聖的光。
footnotes.en: 26:18 1 open This was to carry out the fulfillment of God's jubilee, the acceptable year of the Lord, proclaimed by the Lord Jesus in Luke 4:18-21 (see note Luke 4:19 1 ) according to God's New Testament economy. The first item of the spiritual and divine blessings of the New Testament jubilee, which are the blessings of the gospel of God, is to open the eyes of those who are fallen and turn them from darkness to light, that they may see the divine things in the spiritual realm. To see these things requires spiritual sight and divine light.

footnotes.zh: 黑暗是罪和死的标记；光是义和生命的标记(约一4，八12)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 黑暗是罪和死的標記；光是義和生命的標記。（約一4，八12。）
footnotes.en: 26:18 2 darkness Darkness is a sign of sin and death; light, a sign of righteousness and life (John 1:4; 8:12).

footnotes.zh: 撒但的权势就是撒但的国，这国属于黑暗(太十二26与注1)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 撒但的權勢就是撒但的國，這國屬於黑暗。（太十二26與註1。）
footnotes.en: 26:18 3 authority The authority of Satan is Satan's kingdom, which belongs to darkness (Matt. 12:26 and note Matt. 12:26 1 ).

footnotes.zh: 即转向神的权柄，就是神属于光的国。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即轉向神的權柄，就是神屬於光的國。
footnotes.en: 26:18 4 to I.e., to the authority of God, to God's kingdom, which belongs to light.

footnotes.zh: 赦罪是新约禧年一切福分的基础。
footnotes.zh_big5: 赦罪是新約禧年一切福分的基礎。
footnotes.en: 26:18 5 forgiveness The base of all the blessings of the New Testament jubilee.

footnotes.zh: 原文，复数。
footnotes.zh_big5: 原文，複數。
footnotes.en: 26:18 6 an Lit., a portion; referring to a portion of an inheritance. This inheritance is the Triune God Himself with all He has, all He has done, and all He will do for His redeemed people. The Triune God is embodied in the all-inclusive Christ (Col. 2:9), who is the portion allotted to the saints as their inheritance (Col. 1:12). The Holy Spirit, who has been given to the saints, is the foretaste, the pledge, and the guarantee of this divine inheritance (Rom. 8:23; Eph. 1:14), which we are sharing and enjoying today as a foretaste in God's New Testament jubilee, and which we will enjoy in full in the coming age and for eternity (1 Pet. 1:4). In the type of the jubilee in Lev. 25:8-13, the main blessings are the liberty proclaimed and the returning of every man to his own possession. In the fulfillment of the jubilee here, liberation from the authority of darkness and the receiving of the divine inheritance are the primary blessings (cf. note Acts 20:32 3 ).

To be sanctified positionally is only to have a change in position and purpose; to be sanctified dispositionally is to be transformed in nature by and with the holy nature of God (2 Cor. 3:18). To be sanctified is to be saturated with God as our possession for our enjoyment today. Our sanctification will consummate in our maturity in the divine life that we may resemble God and be qualified to fully possess and enjoy Him as our inheritance in the coming age and for eternity.

refs.text_big5: 那七日將完，從亞西亞來的猶太人，看見保羅在殿裏，就聳動了所有的群眾，下手拿他，
refs.text_en: And when the seven days were about to be concluded, the Jews from Asia saw him in the temple and threw all the crowd into confusion; and they laid their hands on him,

refs.text_gb: 全城都震动了，百姓一齐跑来，拿住保罗，拉他出殿，殿门立刻都关了。
refs.text_big5: 全城都震動了，百姓一齊跑來，拿住保羅，拉他出殿，殿門立刻都關了。
refs.text_en: And the whole city was stirred, and the people ran together; and they laid hold of Paul and dragged him outside the temple; and immediately the doors were shut.

verses.text_gb: 然而我蒙神的[Fn1][Cra]帮助，直到今日还得[Crb]站住，向尊卑老幼[Crc]作见证，所讲的，并不外乎众[Crd]申言者和[Cre]摩西所说，必要发生的事，
verses.text_big5: 然而我蒙神的[Fn1][Cra]幫助，直到今日還得[Crb]站住，向尊卑老幼[Crc]作見證，所講的，並不外乎眾[Crd]申言者和[Cre]摩西所說，必要發生的事，
verses.text_en: Having therefore obtained the help which is from God, I have stood unto this day, testifying both to small and great, saying nothing apart from the things which both the prophets and Moses have said would take place,
verses.text_gb_plain: 然而我蒙神的帮助，直到今日还得站住，向尊卑老幼作见证，所讲的，并不外乎众申言者和摩西所说，必要发生的事，
verses.text_big5_plain: 然而我蒙神的幫助，直到今日還得站住，向尊卑老幼作見證，所講的，並不外乎眾申言者和摩西所說，必要發生的事，

footnotes.zh: 或，协助。原文原意联合。这含示使徒与神联合，并体认神在这联合中的协助。
footnotes.zh_big5: 或，協助。原文原意聯合。這含示使徒與神聯合，並體認神在這聯合中的協助。
footnotes.en: 26:22 1 help Or, assistance. The Greek word originally meant alliance. This implies that the apostle was allied with God and realized God's assistance in this alliance.

refs.text_gb: 所以我们放胆说，“主是帮助我的，我必不惧怕；人能把我怎么样？”
refs.text_big5: 所以我們放膽說，“主是幫助我的，我必不懼怕；人能把我怎麼樣？”
refs.text_en: So that being of good courage, we say, "The Lord is my Helper, and I will not fear. What shall man do to me?"

refs.text_gb: 所以要拿起神全副的军装，使你们在邪恶的日子能以抵挡，并且作成了一切，还能站立得住。
refs.text_big5: 所以要拿起神全副的軍裝，使你們在邪惡的日子能以抵擋，並且作成了一切，還能站立得住。
refs.text_en: Therefore take up the whole armor of God that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

refs.text_gb: 彼得还用许多别的话郑重地作见证，劝勉他们说，你们要得救，脱离这弯曲的世代。
refs.text_big5: 彼得還用許多別的話鄭重的作見證，勸勉他們說，你們要得救，脫離這彎曲的世代。
refs.text_en: And with many other words he solemnly testified and exhorted them, saying, Be saved from this crooked generation.

refs.text_gb: 他们和保罗约定了日子，就有更多的人到他的住所来，保罗从早到晚对他们讲解，郑重见证神的国，引摩西的律法和众申言者的书，以耶稣的事劝服他们。
refs.text_big5: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有更多的人到他的住所來，保羅從早到晚對他們講解，鄭重見證神的國，引摩西的律法和眾申言者的書，以耶穌的事勸服他們。
refs.text_en: And once they had appointed a day for him, many came to him at his lodging, to whom he expounded these matters, solemnly testifying of the kingdom of God and persuading them concerning Jesus from both the Law of Moses and the Prophets, from morning until evening.

refs.text_gb: 众申言者也为祂作见证说，凡信入祂的人，必借着祂的名得蒙赦罪。
refs.text_big5: 眾申言者也為祂作見證說，凡信入祂的人，必藉著祂的名得蒙赦罪。
refs.text_en: To this One all the prophets testify that through His name everyone who believes into Him will receive forgiveness of sins.

refs.text_gb: 但有一件事我要向你承认，就是我正按着他们所称为异端的道路，事奉我们祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的，和申言者书上一切所记载的；
refs.text_big5: 但有一件事我要向你承認，就是我正按著他們所稱為異端的道路，事奉我們祖宗的神，又信合乎律法的，和申言者書上一切所記載的；
refs.text_en: But I confess this to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all the things that are written in the Law and in the Prophets;

refs.text_gb: 于是从摩西和众申言者起，凡经上指着自己的话，都给他们讲解明白了。
refs.text_big5: 於是從摩西和眾申言者起，凡經上指著自己的話，都給他們講解明白了。
refs.text_en: And beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, He explained to them clearly in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

refs.text_gb: 耶稣对他们说，这就是我从前还与你们同在的时候，对你们所说的话：摩西的律法、申言者的书、和诗篇上所记关于我的一切事，都必须应验。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌對他們說，這就是我從前還與你們同在的時候，對你們所說的話：摩西的律法、申言者的書、和詩篇上所記關於我的一切事，都必須應驗。
refs.text_en: And He said to them, These are My words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all the things written in the Law of Moses and the Prophets and Psalms concerning Me must be fulfilled.

refs.text_gb: 他们和保罗约定了日子，就有更多的人到他的住所来，保罗从早到晚对他们讲解，郑重见证神的国，引摩西的律法和众申言者的书，以耶稣的事劝服他们。
refs.text_big5: 他們和保羅約定了日子，就有更多的人到他的住所來，保羅從早到晚對他們講解，鄭重見證神的國，引摩西的律法和眾申言者的書，以耶穌的事勸服他們。
refs.text_en: And once they had appointed a day for him, many came to him at his lodging, to whom he expounded these matters, solemnly testifying of the kingdom of God and persuading them concerning Jesus from both the Law of Moses and the Prophets, from morning until evening.

verses.text_gb: 就是基督必须[Cra]受害，并且首先[Fn1]从死人中[Crb]复活，要将[Fn2][Crc]光传给百姓和外邦人。
verses.text_big5: 就是基督必須[Cra]受害，並且首先[Fn1]從死人中[Crb]復活，要將[Fn2][Crc]光傳給百姓和外邦人。
verses.text_en: That the Christ would suffer and that He, being the first to rise from the dead, would announce light both to the people and to the Gentiles.
verses.text_gb_plain: 就是基督必须受害，并且首先从死人中复活，要将光传给百姓和外邦人。
verses.text_big5_plain: 就是基督必須受害，並且首先從死人中復活，要將光傳給百姓和外邦人。

footnotes.zh: 从死人中复活，直译，从死人的复活中出来。
footnotes.zh_big5: 從死人中復活，直譯，從死人的復活中出來。
footnotes.en: 26:23 1 to Lit., out of the resurrection of the dead.

footnotes.zh: 指明那是光之神(约壹一5)的光照，借着基督荣耀福音的传扬，在那是世界之光(约八12，九5)的基督里照耀(林后四4，6)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 指明那是光之神（約壹一5）的光照，藉著基督榮耀福音的傳揚，在那是世界之光（約八12，九5）的基督裏照耀。（林後四4，6。）
footnotes.en: 26:23 2 light Indicating the enlightenment of God, who is light (1 John 1:5), shining in Christ, who is the light of the world (John 8:12; 9:5), through the preaching of the gospel of the glory of Christ (2 Cor. 4:4, 6).

refs.text_gb: 基督受这些害，又进入祂的荣耀，岂不是应当的么？
refs.text_big5: 基督受這些害，又進入祂的榮耀，豈不是應當的麼？
refs.text_en: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and enter into His glory?

refs.text_gb: 又对他们说，经上这样记着：基督要受害，第三日从死人中复活；
refs.text_big5: 又對他們說，經上這樣記著：基督要受害，第三日從死人中復活；
refs.text_en: And He said to them, Thus it is written, that the Christ would suffer and rise up from the dead on the third day,

refs.text_gb: 但神借着众申言者的口所预先宣告，祂的基督将要受害的事，就这样应验了。
refs.text_big5: 但神藉著眾申言者的口所豫先宣告，祂的基督將要受害的事，就這樣應驗了。
refs.text_en: But the things which God announced beforehand through the mouth of all the prophets, that His Christ would suffer, He has thus fulfilled.

refs.text_gb: 神却将死的痛苦解除，叫祂复活了，因为祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_big5: 神卻將死的痛苦解除，叫祂復活了，因為祂不能被死拘禁。
refs.text_en: Whom God has raised up, having loosed the pangs of death, since it was not possible for Him to be held by it.

refs.text_gb: 你们杀了那生命的创始者，神却叫祂从死人中复活了，我们都是这事的见证人。
refs.text_big5: 你們殺了那生命的創始者，神卻叫祂從死人中復活了，我們都是這事的見證人。
refs.text_en: And the Author of life you killed, whom God has raised from the dead, of which we are witnesses.

refs.text_gb: 我差你到他们那里去，叫他们的眼睛得开，从黑暗转入光中，从撒但权下转向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，并在一切圣别的人中得着基业。
refs.text_big5: 我差你到他們那裏去，叫他們的眼睛得開，從黑暗轉入光中，從撒但權下轉向神，又因信入我，得蒙赦罪，並在一切聖別的人中得著基業。
refs.text_en: To open their eyes, to turn them from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who have been sanctified by faith in Me.

verses.text_gb: 保罗这样分诉，非斯都大声说，保罗，你[Fn1][Cra]癫狂了，你的学问太大，反叫你癫狂了。
verses.text_big5: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說，保羅，你[Fn1][Cra]癲狂了，你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了。
verses.text_en: And as he was saying these things in his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, You are insane, Paul. Much learning is driving you insane.
verses.text_gb_plain: 保罗这样分诉，非斯都大声说，保罗，你癫狂了，你的学问太大，反叫你癫狂了。
verses.text_big5_plain: 保羅這樣分訴，非斯都大聲說，保羅，你癲狂了，你的學問太大，反叫你癲狂了。

footnotes.zh: 或，发疯。下节者同。
footnotes.en: 26:24 1 insane Or, raving mad (so also in the next verse).

refs.text_gb: 耶稣的亲属听见，就出来要拉住祂，因为他们说祂癫狂了。
refs.text_big5: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住祂，因為他們說祂癲狂了。
refs.text_en: And when His relatives heard about it, they went out to lay hold of Him, for they said, He is beside Himself.

refs.text_gb: 因我们或是癫狂，乃是向着神；或是谨守，乃是为着你们。
refs.text_big5: 因我們或是癲狂，乃是向著神；或是謹守，乃是為著你們。
refs.text_en: For whether we were beside ourselves, it was to God; or whether we are sober-minded, it is for you.

verses.text_gb: 保罗说，[Cra]非斯都[Crb]大人，我不是癫狂，我说的乃是[Crc]真实[Crd]清醒的话。
verses.text_big5: 保羅說，[Cra]非斯都[Crb]大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是[Crc]真實[Crd]清醒的話。
verses.text_en: But Paul said, I am not insane, most excellent Festus, but I am uttering words of truth and soberness.
verses.text_gb_plain: 保罗说，非斯都大人，我不是癫狂，我说的乃是真实清醒的话。
verses.text_big5_plain: 保羅說，非斯都大人，我不是癲狂，我說的乃是真實清醒的話。

refs.text_gb: 过了两年，波求非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要讨好犹太人，就留保罗在捆锁中。
refs.text_big5: 過了兩年，波求非斯都接了腓力斯的任；腓力斯要討好猶太人，就留保羅在捆鎖中。
refs.text_en: And when two years were completed, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus; and wanting to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul bound.

refs.text_gb: 腓力斯大人，我们因你得以大享太平，并且这国因你的先见，随事随处得了改革，我们满心感谢的领受。
refs.text_big5: 腓力斯大人，我們因你得以大享太平，並且這國因你的先見，隨事隨處得了改革，我們滿心感謝的領受。
refs.text_en: Both in every way and everywhere, we welcome it, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

refs.text_gb: 以真实的话、以神的大能，借着在右在左义的兵器，
refs.text_big5: 以真實的話、以神的大能，藉著在右在左義的兵器，
refs.text_en: In the word of truth, in the power of God; through the weapons of righteousness on the right and on the left,

refs.text_gb: 因为我若对提多夸奖了你们什么，也不觉得羞愧。相反的，我们对你们所说的一切事，怎样是真实的，我们在提多面前所夸奖你们的，也怎样成了真实的。
refs.text_big5: 因為我若對提多誇獎了你們甚麼，也不覺得羞愧。相反的，我們對你們所說的一切事，怎樣是真實的，我們在提多面前所誇獎你們的，也怎樣成了真實的。
refs.text_en: For if in anything I boasted to him on your behalf, I have not been put to shame; on the contrary, as we spoke all things in truth to you, so also our boasting before Titus turned out to be the truth.

refs.text_gb: 我即使愿意夸口，也不是愚妄，因为我必说真话，只是我惜口不说，恐怕有人评估我，过于他在我身上所看见的，或从我所听见的。
refs.text_big5: 我即使願意誇口，也不是愚妄，因為我必說真話，只是我惜口不說，恐怕有人評估我，過於他在我身上所看見的，或從我所聽見的。
refs.text_en: For if I desire to boast, I will not be foolish, for I will speak the truth; but I refrain lest anyone account of me something above what he sees me to be or hears from me.

refs.text_gb: 因为神赐给我们的，不是胆怯的灵，乃是能力、爱、并清明自守的灵。
refs.text_big5: 因為神賜給我們的，不是膽怯的靈，乃是能力、愛、並清明自守的靈。
refs.text_en: For God has not given us a spirit of cowardice, but of power and of love and of sobermindedness.

refs.text_gb: 劝青年人也是一样，要清明自守。
refs.text_big5: 勸青年人也是一樣，要清明自守。
refs.text_en: The younger men likewise exhort to be of a sober mind,

verses.text_gb: 王也[Fn1]晓得这些事，所以我向王放胆直言，我深信这些事没有一件向王是隐藏的，因为都不是在[Fn2]隐匿的地方作的。
verses.text_big5: 王也[Fn1]曉得這些事，所以我向王放膽直言，我深信這些事沒有一件向王是隱藏的，因為都不是在[Fn2]隱匿的地方作的。
verses.text_en: For the king knows about these things, to whom also I speak freely, for I am persuaded that none of these things have escaped his notice; for this has not been done in a corner.
verses.text_gb_plain: 王也晓得这些事，所以我向王放胆直言，我深信这些事没有一件向王是隐藏的，因为都不是在隐匿的地方作的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 王也曉得這些事，所以我向王放膽直言，我深信這些事沒有一件向王是隱藏的，因為都不是在隱匿的地方作的。

footnotes.zh: 亚基帕是犹太教徒，晓得旧约和复活的事。
footnotes.zh_big5: 亞基帕是猶太教徒，曉得舊約和復活的事。

verses.text_gb: 亚基帕王啊，你信申言者么？我知道你是信的。
verses.text_big5: 亞基帕王阿，你信申言者麼？我知道你是信的。
verses.text_en: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚基帕王啊，你信申言者么？我知道你是信的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞基帕王阿，你信申言者麼？我知道你是信的。

verses.text_gb: 亚基帕对保罗说，你想稍微一劝，便叫我作[Cra]基督徒啊？
verses.text_big5: 亞基帕對保羅說，你想稍微一勸，便叫我作[Cra]基督徒阿？
verses.text_en: And Agrippa replied to Paul, By so little are you trying to persuade me to become a Christian?
verses.text_gb_plain: 亚基帕对保罗说，你想稍微一劝，便叫我作基督徒啊？
verses.text_big5_plain: 亞基帕對保羅說，你想稍微一勸，便叫我作基督徒阿？

refs.text_gb: 找着了，就带他到安提阿去。他们足有一年的时间，在召会里聚集，教训了许多人。门徒称为基督徒，是从安提阿开始。
refs.text_big5: 找著了，就帶他到安提阿去。他們足有一年的時間，在召會裏聚集，教訓了許多人。門徒稱為基督徒，是從安提阿開始。
refs.text_en: And when he found him, he brought him to Antioch. And it happened with them that for a whole year they were gathered in the church and taught a considerable number and that the disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

refs.text_gb: 但若因是基督徒受苦，却不要羞耻，倒要因着这名荣耀神。
refs.text_big5: 但若因是基督徒受苦，卻不要羞恥，倒要因著這名榮耀神。
refs.text_en: But if as a Christian, let him not be ashamed, but let him glorify God in this name.

verses.text_gb: 保罗说，无论是少劝，是多劝，我向神所求的，不但是你一个人，就是今天一切听我的，都要[Cra]像我一样，只是不要有这些[Crb]锁链。
verses.text_big5: 保羅說，無論是少勸，是多勸，我向神所求的，不但是你一個人，就是今天一切聽我的，都要[Cra]像我一樣，只是不要有這些[Crb]鎖鍊。
verses.text_en: And Paul said, I would to God that both by little and by much, not only you, but also all those who hear me today might become even such as I am, except for these bonds.
verses.text_gb_plain: 保罗说，无论是少劝，是多劝，我向神所求的，不但是你一个人，就是今天一切听我的，都要像我一样，只是不要有这些锁链。
verses.text_big5_plain: 保羅說，無論是少勸，是多勸，我向神所求的，不但是你一個人，就是今天一切聽我的，都要像我一樣，只是不要有這些鎖鍊。

refs.text_gb: 我愿意众人都像我一样；只是各人都有自己从神得来的恩赐，有人是这样，有人是那样。
refs.text_big5: 我願意眾人都像我一樣；只是各人都有自己從神得來的恩賜，有人是這樣，有人是那樣。
refs.text_en: Yet I wish all men to be even as I am myself; but each has his own gift from God, one in this way, the other in that.

refs.text_en: And Festus said, King Agrippa, and all you men who are present with us, you behold this man, concerning whom all the multitude of Jews have petitioned me, both in Jerusalem and here, shouting that he ought not to live any longer.

footnotes.zh_big5: 二一27～二六32這一段，很長的記述猶太人對使徒最後的逼迫，把所有有關者的真正特徵都顯明出來：(一)猶太宗教的黑暗、眼瞎、仇恨和假冒為善；(二)羅馬政治的不公正和腐敗；(三)使徒的透亮、光明、忠信和勇敢；(四)主對祂見證人滿有鼓勵的關切，和祂對整個局面的主宰，以完成祂神聖的定旨。
footnotes.en: 26:32 1 This In this section, 21:27—26:32, a long narration of the Jews' final persecution of the apostle, the genuine characteristics of all the involved parties were made manifest: 1) the darkness, blindness, hatred, and hypocrisy of the Jewish religion; 2) the injustice and corruption of Roman politics; 3) the transparency, brightness, faithfulness, and courage of the apostle; 4) the Lord's encouraging care for His witness and His sovereignty over the entire situation for the carrying out of His divine purpose.

refs.text_gb: 我若行了不对的事，犯了什么该死的罪，就是死，我也不辞；但他们所告我的事，若都是虚的，就没有人可以把我交给他们。我上诉于该撒。

refs.text_en: If therefore I am doing wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die; but if there is nothing to the things which these accuse me of, no one can hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar.

refs.text_gb: 无奈犹太人不服，我才被迫上诉于该撒，并非有什么事要控告我本国的百姓。
refs.text_big5: 無奈猶太人不服，我纔被迫上訴於該撒，並非有甚麼事要控告我本國的百姓。
refs.text_en: But when the Jews spoke against this, I was compelled to appeal to Caesar, not that I have anything to accuse my nation of.

refs.text_gb: 他们审问了我，就愿意释放我，因为在我身上并没有该定死罪的。

refs.text_en: Who, having examined me, intended to release me, because there was not one cause of death in me.

verses.text_big5: 但百夫長寧願信從船長和[Cra]船主，卻不信從保羅所說的。
verses.text_en: But the centurion was persuaded by the navigator and the ship's owner rather than by the things that were being said by Paul.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但百夫长宁愿信从船长和船主，却不信从保罗所说的。
verses.text_big5_plain: 但百夫長寧願信從船長和船主，卻不信從保羅所說的。

refs.text_gb: 一个小时之间，这么大的财富竟成了荒凉。凡船长和坐船往各处去的，并众水手，连所有靠海为业的，都远远地站着，
refs.text_big5: 一個小時之間，這麼大的財富竟成了荒涼。凡船長和坐船往各處去的，並眾水手，連所有靠海為業的，都遠遠的站著，
refs.text_en: For in one hour such great wealth has become desolate! And every ship captain and everyone sailing to a place and sailors and all who work on the sea stood afar off

verses.text_gb: 且因这港口不适于过冬，大多数的人就主张从那里开船，或者能到非尼喀过冬。非尼喀是革哩底的一个港口，[Fn1]一面朝东北，一面朝东南。
verses.text_big5: 且因這港口不適於過冬，大多數的人就主張從那裏開船，或者能到非尼喀過冬。非尼喀是革哩底的一個港口，[Fn1]一面朝東北，一面朝東南。
verses.text_en: And as the harbor was not suitable for wintering, the majority gave counsel to put out to sea from there, if somehow they might be able to reach Phoenix, a harbor of Crete facing northeast and southeast, and spend the winter there.
verses.text_gb_plain: 且因这港口不适于过冬，大多数的人就主张从那里开船，或者能到非尼喀过冬。非尼喀是革哩底的一个港口，一面朝东北，一面朝东南。
verses.text_big5_plain: 且因這港口不適於過冬，大多數的人就主張從那裏開船，或者能到非尼喀過冬。非尼喀是革哩底的一個港口，一面朝東北，一面朝東南。

verses.text_gb: 这时微微起了南风，他们以为对目的地已有把握，就起锚，贴近革哩底航行。
verses.text_big5: 這時微微起了南風，他們以為對目的地已有把握，就起錨，貼近革哩底航行。
verses.text_en: And when a south wind blew gently, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete close inshore.
verses.text_gb_plain: 这时微微起了南风，他们以为对目的地已有把握，就起锚，贴近革哩底航行。
verses.text_big5_plain: 這時微微起了南風，他們以為對目的地已有把握，就起錨，貼近革哩底航行。

verses.text_gb: 但过了不久，一股名叫[Fn1]友拉革罗的狂[Cra]风，从岛上扑下来，
verses.text_big5: 但過了不久，一股名叫[Fn1]友拉革羅的狂[Cra]風，從島上撲下來，
verses.text_en: But not long afterward there beat down from the island a hurricane wind called Euraquilo.
verses.text_gb_plain: 但过了不久，一股名叫友拉革罗的狂风，从岛上扑下来，
verses.text_big5_plain: 但過了不久，一股名叫友拉革羅的狂風，從島上撲下來，

footnotes.zh_big5: 即東北風。
footnotes.en: 27:14 1 the Lit., it.

refs.text_gb: 忽然起了大风暴，波浪打入船内，甚至船要满了水。
refs.text_big5: 忽然起了大風暴，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
refs.text_en: And there arose a great windstorm, and the waves beat into the boat, so that the boat was already beginning to fill up.

verses.text_gb: 船被风抓住，敌不住风，我们就任风刮去，
verses.text_big5: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去，
verses.text_en: And when the ship was caught by it and was not able to face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.
verses.text_gb_plain: 船被风抓住，敌不住风，我们就任风刮去，
verses.text_big5_plain: 船被風抓住，敵不住風，我們就任風颳去，

verses.text_gb: 贴着一个小岛的背风岸奔航，那岛名叫高大，我们好不容易才[Fn1]收住[Cra]小艇。
verses.text_big5: 貼著一個小島的背風岸奔航，那島名叫高大，我們好不容易纔[Fn1]收住[Cra]小艇。
verses.text_en: And running under the shelter of a certain little island called Clauda, we were hardly able to get control of the small boat.
verses.text_gb_plain: 贴着一个小岛的背风岸奔航，那岛名叫高大，我们好不容易才收住小艇。
verses.text_big5_plain: 貼著一個小島的背風岸奔航，那島名叫高大，我們好不容易纔收住小艇。

footnotes.zh: 即将小艇紧系在甲板上。风平浪静时，小艇是由绳索系于船尾(Vincent，文生)。
footnotes.zh_big5: 即將小艇緊繫在甲板上。風平浪靜時，小艇是由繩索繫於船尾。（Vincent，文生。）
footnotes.en: 27:16 1 get I.e., to secure on deck the small boat, which in calm weather was attached by a rope to the vessel's stern (Vincent).

refs.text_gb: 水手想要离船逃走，就把小艇放在海里，假作要从船头抛锚的样子。
refs.text_big5: 水手想要離船逃走，就把小艇放在海裏，假作要從船頭拋錨的樣子。
refs.text_en: And when the sailors sought to flee from the ship, having lowered the small boat into the sea under pretense of intending to lay out anchors from the bow,

verses.text_gb: 既把小艇拉上来，就[Fn1]用缆绳捆绑船底；又[Cra]恐怕撞在[Fn2]赛耳底沙滩上，就[Fn3]放下帆来，任船飘流。
